title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
author: J. K. Rowling
summary:
Lord Voldemort has returned to power, and his wrath has been felt in both the Muggle and Wizarding worlds. Severus Snape, long considered an enemy of Voldemort and a member of Dumbledore’s anti-Voldemort coalition, the Order of the Phoenix, meets with Narcissa Malfoy, mother of Draco and wife of Lucius, an imprisoned Death Eater. Snape makes an Unbreakable Vow to Narcissa, promising to protect her son, Draco.

Dumbledore heads to 4 Privet Drive to collect Harry from his aunt and uncle. On their way to the Burrow, Harry and Dumbledore stop to recruit Horace Slughorn to return to teaching at Hogwarts. Harry is reunited with his best friends, Ron and Hermione. When shopping for schoolbooks, Harry runs into Draco and follows him to Borgin and Burkes, where he overhears Draco threatening Borgin and insisting that he fix an unknown object. Harry is instantly suspicious of Draco, whom he believes to be a Death Eater, just like his father. The students return to school, and Dumbledore announces that Snape will be teaching Defense Against the Dark Arts, much to Harry’s surprise.

Harry receives a used Potions textbook that once belonged to someone named “The Half-Blood Prince.” Spells and amendments are written in the margins of the book, and Harry uses the Prince’s notes to excel at Potions. Dumbledore schedules regular meetings with Harry in which they use Dumbledore’s pensieve to look at memories of those who have had direct contact with Voldemort. Dumbledore believes that if Harry can learn enough about Voldemort’s history, it will help him when they finally fight face to face, as the prophecy concerning Harry foretells. Harry learns about Voldemort’s family, including his grandfather Marvolo, his uncle Morfin, and his mother Merope, who fed a Muggle (Tom Riddle Sr.) a love potion and was abandoned by him when it wore off. Voldemort was left at an orphanage and grew to be an unpleasant and aggressive boy. Harry also learns that Voldemort has divided his soul into seven Horcruxes, by coercing Slughorn to give him an old memory. Two of these, Tom Riddle’s diary and Marvolo’s ring, have already been destroyed. One resides in Voldemort, one resides in a snake, one is Merope’s locket, and the other two are suspected to be hidden in objects belonging to Hufflepuff, Ravenclaw, or Gryffindor.

Ron acquires a new girlfriend, Lavender, of whom Hermione is extremely jealous. Harry feels stuck in the middle of his friends’ bickering. Eventually, Harry falls in love with Ginny, Ron’s sister, and Ron and Lavender break up, making Hermione quite happy. Harry spends much of his time keeping up with his duties as Quidditch captain and following Draco Malfoy. Harry uses his Marauder’s Map to keep track of Draco, but often cannot find him on the map. Eventually, Harry realizes that when Draco is not on the map, he is using the Room of Requirement on the seventh floor of Hogwarts, which transforms into whatever its user needs, thanks to Dobby helping him and ordering Kreature to follow Draco. Harry tries his best to get in to see what Draco is up to, but until he knows exactly what Draco is using the room for, he cannot gain access. Eventually Harry and Dumbledore leave Hogwarts together to fetch and destroy Merope’s locket, thus making Voldemort one step closer to mortal. They must overcome a variety of traps and challenges before reaching the basin where the locket is hidden under a poisonous potion. Dumbledore drinks the potion and Dumbledore fights off Voldemort’s Inferi. They take the locket and return to Hogwarts as quickly as possible. Dumbledore is quite weak, and when they reach Hogsmeade they can see that the Dark Mark is visible above the astronomy tower.

Harry and Dumbledore rush toward the tower. When they arrive, Dumbledore uses his magic to freeze Harry in place, while Harry remains hidden by his cloak of invisibility. Draco Malfoy sprints into the room, threatening Dumbledore’s life. Weak and with his wand disarmed by Draco, Dumbledore stalls Draco, telling him that he is not a killer and that the Order of the Phoenix could protect him and his mother from Voldemort. Draco lowers his wand, and Snape pushes into the tower. Harry cannot move or speak, but he hears members of the Order fighting Death Eaters below. Snape raises his wand and kills Dumbledore, sending him flying over the edge of the tower. When Dumbledore dies, his spell on Harry is broken, and Harry rushes after Snape, determined to avenge the death of his friend and headmaster. Snape escapes, and Harry is devastated. He looks at the locket he and Dumbledore retrieved and realizes that it is not a Horcrux. Inside the locket is a note from someone named “R. A. B.” Harry tells his friends he will not be returning to Hogwarts next year and will instead search out and kill Voldemort by destroying all of the Horcruxes. Ron and Hermione vow to join him.

title: The Lightning Thief
author: Rick Riordan
summary:
The Lightning Thief Summary Rich Riordan Percy Jackson and the Olympians #1

Percy Jackson is a 12 year old 6th grader at Yancy Academy in upstate New York. He has been kicked out or expelled from school every year, and is now at a school for “troubled” kids. His only friend is a scrawny kid with a limp named Grover, and they get picked on by Nancy Bobofit who the teachers like. They are going on a field trip to a local museum to see ancient Greek stuff. The latin teacher, Mr. Brenner (uses a wheelchair), always pushes Percy hard and says he can do great things. At one point Nancy is harassing Grover and Percy “pushes” (he is not sure what happened) her into the fountain. The mean math teacher, Mrs. Dodds, takes him away for a talk, but then transforms into a leathery vulture monster in private and attacks him. Mr. Brenner appears and throws him a pen which becomes a sword and percy kills her. He seems to pass out for a second and when he regains consciousness everything is normal again. No one remembers a teacher named Mrs. Dodds, but Percy thinks Grover is lying when he says that.

Back at school one evening, Percy overhears Grover and Mr. Brenner talking about strange things and that he may be in danger. At the end of the year he confronts Grover about it and Grover tells him he is his protector, and Percy should wait for him and be careful, but Percy ditches him and heads home. His mom, Sally Jackson, was forced to drop out of school young and works in a candy shop. His step-dad, Gabe Ugliano (Smelly Gabe), is a gross vile man who is rude to both Percy and his mom. When percy gets home his mom says they are going to go to a cabin in Montauk for a short vacation. When they get there Grover shows up as a storm is brewing and tells them they all need to run. Except Grover is not crippled anymore, he has goat legs and is a Satyr. Sally drives the three of them somewhere, demanding explanations from Percy as they go. They are close to their destination, a hill with a tall pine tree, when lightning hits the car and they crash. Grover is unconscious and they are pulling him towards the hill when a Minotaur shows up and chases them. Sally tries to distract it but is grabbed and being crushed when she turns into golden light and disappears. Percy is angry (he has temper control problems) and kills the minotaur with it’s own horn, then passes out.

He wakes up in Camp Half-Blood, a safe haven for children the Greek Gods have with mortals (of course no one bothers explaining this to Percy really). A girl named Annabeth Chase, daughter of Athena, helps nurse him back to health with Ambrosia and Nectar, food and drink of the gods. His latin teacher, Mr. Brenner, is actually the centaur Chiron, famed teacher of heroes from myth. And the camp is run by Mr. D, the god Dionysus here on punishment detail. Percy is temporarily put in Cabin 11 with all the Hermes kids and kids whose godly parentage is unknown. The cabin leader, Luke, is about 19 and kind to Percy. Annabeth has a crush on him. He does not excel at any skills until sword fighting, where he is a natural and able to disarm Luke, who is a very good swordsman. Water seems to make him stronger. He makes an enemy of Clarisse, a daughter of Ares.

They play capture the flag and Percy beats a whole group of Ares kids while standing in a creek, and his team wins. But suddenly a hellhound shows up and before Chiron kills it, it savages Percy a bit. But the creek heals him almost instantly, and Poseidon claims him via a floating trident hologram symbol.

Percy learns the “Big Three” (the gods Zeus, Poseidon, and Hades, not a basketball term) are not supposed to have children since their kids started WWII, but first Zeus and now Poseidon have broken the rules. There is some big prophecy no one will tell Percy about, but their is a little prophecy and he gets to go on a quest since someone stole Zeus’ master lightning bolt. He goes and talks to the Oracle of Delphi in the attic of the Big House, and him, Annabeth, and Grover set out. Percy learns over time the pine tree on the hill is Zeus’ daughter Thalia, who he turned into a tree when she was about to die fighting monsters to defend Annabeth, Luke, and Grover. Before they leave, Luke gives Percy a pair of flying shoes (which Percy gives to Grover because son of Poseidon would not be flying), and Chiron gives him a pen that turns into a sword, Riptide (anaklusmos or something in greek). They need to return Zeus’ master bolt by the summer solstice (10 days) or their will probably be a war. They assume Hades stole it so they head to Los Angeles, entrance to the underworld.

Argus drives them a bus station. It turns out Percy is a wanted criminal for the destruction of Gabe’s car and his mom’s disappearance. On the bus they shortly get attacked by the three furies, one of whom is Mrs. Dodds, servants of Hades who say they want something. They manage to escape and flee the crashed bus to Aunty Em’s Garden Emporium. A nearby waystation with lots of odd statues around. Aunty Em is very kind and gives them food but something seems off and Grover recognizes one of the statues as his Uncle Ferdinand and this is Medusa’s lair and Percy cuts off her head. In a fit of anger he mails it to Mount Olympus, which is on the 600th floor of the Empire State Building.

They are able to buy train tickets heading to Denver. They take a stop at St. Louis, and while in the gateway arch, Percy is attacked by Echidna and a Chimera, forced to jump into the river below, where he learns he can breath underwater. A voice tells him to go to the Santa Monica Pier in Los Angeles. They all get back to the train and head to Denver. They are out of money and supplies, but then when at a local diner the god Ares shows up, buys them food, and says if they retrieve his shield from a local abandoned waterpark he will help them on their quest and share info about Percy’s mom. They retrieve the shield, which was in a trap by Hephaestus for Ares and Aphrodite. Very dangerous, almost die and Annabeth has a deadly fear of spiders but they escape. They return the shield, Ares says Sally is alive, and tells them to get in the back of a semi headed to LA. He also gives Percy a backpack with some supplies to help them.

The semi is a shady animal transport business, and the animals are miserable. grover , being a Satyr, can talk to animals and do minor nature magic. Percy can talk to the zebra because Poseidon is lord of horses. They free the animals when the truck stops in Las Vegas and are forced to run. They end up in the Lotus Casino, where they are given free money and room and decide to stay and play some games. Percy realizes something is off when a dude who thinks it is 1977 is playing next to him. He gets Annabeth and Grover and they get out, and realize 5 days have passed while they were in there. They use the casino card to get a taxi to LA.

They arrive at the Santa Monica pier and a niaid gives Percy three pearls that can help them. They are looking for the under world entrance, a DOA recording studios, when they enter Procrustes waterbed shop, where he stretches and chops customers to fit beds exactly six feet. Percy kills him and saves Annabeth and Grover and the find DOA studios. Charon, the receptionist, agrees to take them for a bunch of gold Drachmas they took from Crusty. They cross a polluted river Styx and use a red ball to distract Cerberus, who just seems sad. As they wander Grover’s flying shoes activate and start pulling him away, he is almost sucked into a big pit when one falls off and they save him and run from the pit, Percy’s backpack starting to feel heavy. Percy has been having dreams of this pit, a voice coming from it and Annabeth has suspicions about what it is.

They arrive at Hades palace and he accuses them of stealing his helm of darkness. They say No, and percy opens his backpack to reveal the master bolt. He does not know how it got there. Hades offers Sally back (he has her frozen in time) in exchange for his helm, but they don’t have it so use the pearls to flee. Back on shore they meet Ares, who they realize must have tricked them. Ares has the helm of darkness, and Percy challenges him to a fight for it. They duel in the see and Percy is able to land a strike to his heel.A bunch of cops and people are watching (percy is still wanted). Ares says he got lucky and he should be careful, as he will never help him in battle or something. Ares wanted a war to start between gods (god of war), but they know someone else came up with the plan. They return the helm to a fury who flies over, and then go talk to people. The Mist, a strange substance which keeps mortals from seeing the supernatural world, convinces people percy was actually held captive by the strange man (Ares) and he is now a hero. Despite him being warned not to, it is the day of the solstice and the only way to reach NYC and Mt. Olympus is to fly on a plane. They make it and Percy sends Annabeth and Grover to camp to tell Chiron while he goes to the Empire State building. He meets the gods, and returns the bolt and explains everything. Zeus decides not to kill him, and he meets his dad, who says he is proud of him and Percy is a true son of the sea god.

He returns home to find his mom returned by Hades, and the head of Medusa on his bed. He offers to use it on Gabe, since he realized that gabe has abused his mom before. Sally says no, I’ll handle it. A week later, he gets a note saying Gabe disappeared and his mom sold a lifelike stone statue for a lot of money so she could go back to college. Back at camp, Percy is a hero. He talks to Chiron and Annabeth and they all decide Kronos, titan and father of Zeus, imprisoned in Tartarus, is behind these thefts. But Percy is angry because Zeus won’t do anything about it. At the end of the summer Percy needs to decide if he stays at camp or goes back to school. Annabeth has decided to reconnect with her family, and leaves with her mortal dad. Percy goes to train and think and finds Luke. They go to talk in the woods and Luke summons a pit scorpion to threaten Percy, then tells him how he is the one who stole the bolt and helm and serves Kronos. He is resentful towards the gods of Olympus. He vanishes and the scorpion stings Percy, but he manages to reach Chiron and is saved. Then decides to go be with his mom and go to school for the year. THE END.

Empire of the Vampire Jay Kristoff Empire of the Vampire #1

Characters: Gabriel de León Amélie - Sister Celene - Sister Auriél de León - Mother Raphael Castia - stepfather

Julieta Isla Père Louis

Frère Greyhand Archer Winter Aaron De Coste Astrid Rennier Abbot Khalid Seraph Talon De Montfort Justice Chloe Sauvage Baptiste Sa-Ismael

Saoirse Phoebe - Lioness Père Rafa Bellamy Bouchette Dior Lachance

Vampires: Ironhearts - Blood Voss Shepherds - Blood Chastain Untamed - Dyvok Whispers - Ilon Faithless - Esani

Fabién Voss, the Forever King Danton Voss Marquis Jean-François (Blood Chastain) Liathe

Places: Empire of Elidaen Lorson, in the Nordlund - Gabriel’s hometown San Michon San Guillaume Avelene

We start with Gabriel De Leon imprisoned in a tower room, he has apparently killed someone called the forever king. It is night and vampires roam the outside world. Someone comes to his cell, a vampire called jean-Francois, and his thrall woman. He tells gabriel that the queen Margaret Chastain has decided she wants his story. At first Gabriel says no but he is going through withdrawal and they offer him some sanctus to smoke so he agrees. The story Gabriel tells follows two different timelines, his childhood, and a more recent one where he worked to find the holy grail of San Michon.

He was born in a small town called Lorson. His father was a drunk and abusive at times, but also an ex-soldier and blacksmith so he taught him useful skills. His mother, an exiled Noble De Leon, loved him deeply and taught him to be brave and proud. His sisters Amelie and Celene he also liked.

Something called “Daysdeath” happened when he was like 7-8, and the sun stoped being as bright and powerful, limiting what crops they could grow and making winter longer, but also opening the door for other horrors. One day Amelie and a local friend Julieta (Gabe’s first kiss), went out into the woods and did not come back. Eventually they returned as “Wretched”, vampires more like zombies, strong and fast but only craving blood. Gabe was forced to help kill his own sister. He hated the local priest, Louis, for not burying her. Eventually he is older and sleeps with a girl named Ilsa, but ends up biting her and drinking her blood. It makes him fast and strong and heal quickly and he is confused and a mob attacks him. But then 2 figures show up, Greyhound and Aaron De Coste. They take Gabriel away and tell him he is Paleblood. Half-Vampire. Now that the sun does not work Vampires can move during the day, although they are still strongest at night. They teach him about the Ordo Argent, the silver order, a group of palebloods who fight evil in the name of the Lord and Mothermaid. They take him to San Michon, in a valley are 7 stone pillars with flat tops kind of and they build a monastery and stuff up there. It is still being repaired since the EMpress Isabella recently gave them patronage. Gabe meets Abbot Khalid, and he also hates Aaron since aaron judges him a peasant and is rude. A group of Nuns, the silver sisters, also live and work at the monastery. Gabe meets a blacksmith, Baptiste, who gives him a silversteel sword he names Lionclaw. Later he goes to pick out a Sosya horse, and meets a girl named Astrid Rennier who says it is her horse Justice, so he keeps the name. Members of the silver order are called Silversaints, and get silver tattoos all over their body that glow when they fight. Astrid inks his first tattoo, a sevenstar, on his left palm.

Cut to other story, Gabe is brought Wine by the thrall in real time. Gabriel is traveling at night, riding Justice, when some wretched start chasing him. Justice hits a rabbit hole and breaks his leg so Gabe has to kill him and run. He comes upon some inquisitors, and shoots one and steals her horse, fleeing to a nearby town. He names the new horse Jezebel and goes and gets drunk. Suddenly Chloe Sauvage, a Silver Sister from San Michon, shows up with a priest, bard, Irish-Clan warrior and her lion, and a small street rat boy. We learn Gabriel has left Astrid, his wife, and their daughter patience at home to come north for something. She is excited to see him but he is sad and drunk and goes to bed. In the night someone knocks on his window and he invites her in. In the morning Chloe has already left but Danton Voss, a highblood vampire, highbloods are much more powerful and have bloodline abilities, is at the town gate so Gabriels smokes Sanctus (Distilled vampire blood that makes palebloods faster and stronger), and fights him. He kills his “daughter” and cuts off his arm so Danton retreats. He does learn the Danton was chasing the boy with Chloe, so he decides to follow them.

Jean-Francois asks how we went from him just meeting Astrid to her being his wife so the story goes back. Gabriel is learning to be a silversaint. Seraph Talon tests him for a bloodline ability. Dyvok - Superstrength, Voss - Iron skin and better mind powers, Ilon - Emotional and mind control, Chastain - Animal Control. Gabe is none of them, a frailblood, and is mocked a lot for it, so he focuses on training and bladework. Him, Aaron, and Greyhand set out on a hunt. They come to a rich town called Skyefall, and discover a vampire highblood came through and turned some people. When a vampire kills someone they have a chance to come back to life as a vampire, but it is not 100%, and some come back as highbloods some as wretched based on who killed them. They go to the catacombs and Gabriel disobeys orders, allowing a fledgling Highblood to escape. Greyhound almost kills him but sends him back to the manor to watch the lady, who a vampire has been feeding on. The local priest comes and poisons Gabe, then a vampire boy (son of the lady) comes in and Gabe has top fight and kill all of them. The lady is a thrall to the boy (If you drink a vampire blood 3 times you become their slave), and she kills her husband in the fight. Gabriel eventually gets his hand around the vampire boys arm and burns his arm off somehow. No one knows what happened, but they return to San Michon with 2 vampire prisoners.

Gabe overhears Talon and Greyhand talking about a supposed “fifth bloodline” and that they may kill him for it, so he wants to learn more. That night he sneaks out to the library to peruse the forbidden section, since any library in a fantasy series has one. He meets Astrid Rennier also sneaking out there, and they talk and he learns she is the bastard daughter of the emperor alexander, and was sent here in exile when he married isabella. She is angry and smokes dreamweed, but agrees to help him look for this fifth bloodline. She is searching for a way to end Daysdeath. They slowly become friends and evcentually Astrid brings another nun in training Chloe. Chloe wants to learn to use a sword and Gabe agrees so she also helps them search. Gabe is in the stables one morning (his punishment for disobedience on the hunt was cleaning the stables each morn), and is attacked by a vampire he kills with Justice’s help. That morning he had seen both Aaron sneaking out of the Armory (where the vampire was chained up), and Sister Aoife (Talon’s aide) crying in the cathedral. He learns the vampire killed Aoife on her way to him. His already bad animosity with Aaron become murderous, since he thinks Aaron tried to kill him.

Jump back to modern time, Gabriel catches up to Chloe’s party fighting some Wretched and helps kill them, but a mysterious highblood called Liathe also shows up, helps, then asks for the boy to come with her. She shows some weird blood powers. They say no and she leaves for now. Gabriel learns the priest is Pere Rafa, the bard/soothsinger Bellamy from Isabella’s own court in Avignon or wherever. The irish slayer lady is Saoirse and her lioness Phoebe, and the boy Dior Lachance, who is a teenage city thief. They say dior knows where the Holy Grail is, which a prophecy says can end Daysdeath and save the empire. Gabe agrees to travel with them until the Volta, then continue on his business. They are still chased by both Danton Voss and the Inquisition for some reason. They come to an old abandoned town in winter, and are forced to defend a group of wretched. Rafa and bellamy are about to die, but Dior’s blood on their wounds heals and saves them. Chloe explains Dior IS the holy grail, and San Michon had the redeemers child, and the line of Esan has continued to Dior, a direct descendant of their savior.

Cut. Time to leave San Michon for another hunt. This time Seraph Talon joins Aaron, gabe, and Greyhand since they know they are hunting a highblood vampire. They travel long and Aaron and Gabe still hate each other, and Talon is also cruel, but trains them well. They arrive in Aaron’s hometown of Coste, where the vampire is, and it is a feast day so they pose as servants and such. They spot the vampire, and Greyhand says to let her take a victim so they can follow and wait for morning, when she will be weaker, but Gabe steps in and saves the victim (Aaron’s cousin), allowing the vampire to escape. Greyhound is furious and almost killes Gabe but Aaron stands up for him, later thanking him for saving his cousin. They track the vampires to a house where some people have been drank from, and confront her on a bridge (Vampires can’t cross running water without a bridge and can’t enter a home without being invited). The battle is brutal, but they kill her highblood son, then learn this is Laure Voss, daughter of the forever king Fabien Voss (leader of a vampire army), and a prince of forever. She rips of Greyhands arm and eye, guts gabe and Aaron, and starts to say some secrets about Talon when he rushes her and she impales him also. Gabe is able to shove a silverbomb down her throat and pull his compatriots to the safety of a cathedral. Voss is not dead but she vows vengeance and flees. They return to San Michon, and Aaron and Gabe seem to have grown to tolerate each other after that battle. Not friends yet but they don’t hate each other.

Cut. Gabe, CHloe, and the party are out of horses and food besides Jezebel after having to jump a river to avoid Danton again, so they head to San Guillame, another monastery that Rafa is from. They need to resupply. They arrive there and find the place has been butchered by the inquisition. There is some food but no horses, and Danton is closing in on them with a lot of wretched at his command. They prepare their defenses and have to battle off Liathe again, when she comes to collect Dior. They battle Danton and are doing alright but then Danton kills Saoirse and Phoebe, then Bellamy as they retreat to the cathedral. They manage to burn a ton of wretched through Gabriels trickery, but Danton still kils Rafa and Gabe, Chloe, and Dior have to jump into the VOlta from very high, but Danton catches Dior so chloe falls intentionally to free gabes other arm. He saves Dior and they are alone huddled in a cave with no supplies, Jezebel fled San Guillame in the battle. Gabe also has no pipe or sanctus so his addiction will grow stronger.

Cut. Gabriel has been punished for disobedience on another hunt, and greyhound said he will never hunt with him again. But Astrid and Chloe found something on the fifth bloodline. Esani, the faithless, who can use sanguimancy. Even other vampires hate them. Oh also when they fought laure voss, greyhound, who is of blood chastain, used his hawk archer to kill a messenger dove and they learn Fabien Voss is planning to invade in winter, so the kings army is marching north due to the battle plans they obtained. Isabella herself comes to San Michon to prepare. Greyhound speaks his concern the note was a trick, and Gabriels suggests he take the initiates to the southern broder city to defend. He agrees bu then later says he will not take gabe. Astrid and Gabe start getting very close, and have sexy time but are interuppted by alarm bells.Seraph Talon has discovered Aaron and Baptiste being gay in the armory, which is a crime according the bible. Gabe found out about his a while ago but kept their secret. Which earned him Aaron’s trust. They are going to be exiled but after the battle, so they are imprisoned.. Once everyone else has left gabe gets blood on the note they took from the vampire and finds a secret message saying Fabien Voss is taking his army through a different mountain pass, inaccessible to mortals but the dead will be fine. Him, Astrid, and Chlose gather those left behind, the nuns, Gabe, blackthumbs (blacksmiths), and Aaron and Baptiste. They send runners to let the other groups know what is happening and ascend into the freezing cold and snow. They finally reach the pass and see a huge army of wretched. Gabe plans to set off an avalanche with black ignis poweder to bury them, but when they are setting it Laure Voss attacks their backline of sisters and he goes to save Astrid. Prioress Charlotte dies but Gabe is able to get his hand around Laure’s neck and sanguimances her to burn her to death. Fabien is enraged and enters his head and Gabe sees him, but then they set off the avalanche and bury the army and block the pass. Before killing Laure she revealed she went to Lorson and butchered everyone in revenge. The other silversaints arrive and everyone returns home, but Gabe stops at Lorson first and finds his whole family dead, Celene burned to a crisp in the church. He is devestated and returns to San Michon, where he is named a full member of the silver order, and Empress Isabella herself knights him a chevalier and sword of the realm. Aaron and Baptiste are still exiled, and Gabe lays a trap for Seraph Talon in the library, where he exposes him as having been drinking Aoifes blood and sleeping with her. He has given into his vampire ways and craves blood. Talon attacks but greyhand was waiting in the wings and saves Gabe and kills Talon. When Palebloods get old and their blood thirst “Sangire” gets too strong they are supposed to perform the Red Rite, let the abbot kill them. Greyhand takes Gabe to the infirmary where Astrid finds him and they copulate. They love each other, but have to keep it a secret.

Cut. Gabe and Dior are struggling along. Oh also Gabriel is famous, he did a ton of stuff was called the Black Lion, he is a hero and helped a ton in the war. He wields Ashdrinker, a sword forged of starmetal that can destroy vampires. But him and Astrid got expelled from San Michon when she got pregnant with their daughter patience. So no one has seen him in a decade. Dior and gabe find a barge and make their way to a town. On the barge Dior uses her power to save a dying man in secret. They need to find Sanctus, Gabe is barely able to move anymore. Dior steals supplies from a merchant but before he can smoke guards appear, informed by the daughters of the man Dior saved, and the inquisition takes them captive. Gabe is being tortured by the same inquisitor he shot a long time ago, when Dior shows up and saves him. They grab their supplies and are able to flee on a rowboat. They have become friends despite initial animosity (Trend). They cross wintery land, and then Jezebel finds them, and they cross frozen rivers which is bad because that means vampires can also cross. Eventually while fleeing some dark magic Jezebel, renamed Fortuna by Dior, falls off a cliff and dies, but they shelter in her warm death to avoid dying themselves. They struggle along to Avalene, a small stronghold run by Aaron de Coste and Baptiste. This is where Gabriel and Astrid got married and Patience was born. They are all happy to see each other. Yippee. But Dior finally gets Gabe to tell why he came north. He had been living in the south on a small island Lighthouse with Patience and Astrid when after 11 years Fabien Voss and all his children showed up and killed Patience and turned Astrid. Gabe broke the tip off ashdrinker striking voss’ neck. He was then forced to kill Astrid himself to stop her from being a vampire. They have been dead all along and that is why he drinks and is sad. He only wants revenge. Also his silverclad tattoos have not been glowing because he no longer has any faith in the lord. Then Danton shows up outside and says if they do not give him Dior he will butcher everyone here. Dior flees in the night to save the good people their, but Gabe gets a dogsled from Aaron and chases after her. Dior does a trick blowing up the ice and kills a ton of wretched, but Danton and 10 other highbloods still are there. Dior’s blood also burns vampires. She uses this to reach Gabe and they prepare to fight. Aaron told Gabe he had to have faith in something, and he does have faith in Dior. His tattoos glow crimson, hurting the vampires. Liathe also shows up and helps. Gabe and Dior take on Danton, a prince of forever, while Liathe holds off 10 highbloods alone. Gabe is fighting Danton but Danton is wearing him down, when Dior rubs her blood on Ashdrinker and stabs him from behind, burning him to death. Liathe kills a few highbloods and the rest flee. Liathe again pleads that Dior come with her, since she knows nothing but Gabe and Dior say No. A group of Silversaints Gabe knows from being initiates arrives, including Greyhand who is now Abbot, and they all return to San Michon. Everything is happy at first, but then Greyhand lets slip that the ritual to end Daysdeath involves sacrificing Dior at dawn. Gabe protests and fights back but Greyhand and 5 silversaints subdue him and force the red rite on him, slitting his throat and throwing him from the plateau to the river below. Gabe wakes up with Liathe standing over him. He has drank her blood and she saved him from death. He is furious at first, but then realizes Liathe is a title, the vampire is his sister Celene. He is confused and shocked and she says she hates him and he has a lot to learn. Gabe climbs back up and kills most of the silversaints there and Chloe to save Dior, and they flee together. THE END.

Of War and Ruin Ryan Cahill The Bound and The Broken #3

Calen Bryer, our hero, and soulkin of Valerys, has just helped defend the city of Kingspass from a Urak invasion. There, the Knights of Akyron came to help and Calen saw his dead brother Haim, who is now Ardyn. This messes with him. He, Eric, Talman, and Veryl all decide to cross the burnt lands to rescue Rist. Since the old Grandmaster of the knights died, Kallinvar has to take up the mantle.

Meanwhile, Farda Kairana escorted Ella and Faenir to Berona, where she met with Tanner Fjorn (Rhett’s uncle and commander of the Berona city guard). Tanner turns out to be a rebel and they escape the people Farda sent after them. Ella discovers she is a druid. Tanner is injured.

In the Dwarven kingdoms, Dahlen and Ivan try to keep the new, young, stupid king Damon alive. Belina is an ex-assassin who helps Dahlen in this venture. Eventually Damon and Ivan are killed in the midst of Dwarven infighting. The dwarven queen, Kyra, helps the human Belduaran refugees and names the fat ambassador as their new ruler. Dahlen and Belina escort a ton of refugees to Aravel, the elf kingdom.

Rist is making good progress under Brother Gerimund’s tutelage in Al’Nasla. He begins dating Nira, a fellow battlemage, and they are eventually sent out into battle for the first time against different elves who also have dragons.

Valtara: city in the south, home to Wyvern riders. Now that Dayne has come home, he convince his sister and leader of the house Alina to begin a rebellion. Many of the local squabbling nobles are against it so they have to waste a ton of time fighting their own people instead of the empire.

Calen makes it across the burnt lands, kills Inquuisitor Rendel, who killed his dad, and frees Rist’s Parents and the elf Galeron, but NO RIST. Then they go back across the burnt lands to join with Aeson and Therin and Dan and go to the elven city of Aravel to train.

Ella Joins more rebels and they plan to attack the Lorian army (They Rist is now a part of) while they are distracted by the elves. Ella and Faenir are captured and tortured a bit, before Rist and Farda set her free and Farda flees with her and Tanner to Aravel.

After all of our characters have gathered at Aravel and done the training montage (we also learn Vars Bryer was apparently one of the worlds most famous heroes of all time), they are attacked! By Lorian’s and part of the dragon guard. Big battle, no one super important dies, the ”broken” Dragons and riders serperated from their soulkin finally join in and help save Calen, Ella also overextends her Druid powers to save Calen and is now broken ish.

The blood moon rises. Fane’s grand plot to bring Efialtir’s chosen into the world is a go. Urak, Knights of Achyron, and Lorian’s battle.

A Civil War in Valtara This storybeat/plotline takes place in three parts. Initial unity in opposition to the Loren Empire The hints of dissent against House Ateres Open revolt against House Ateres The Temptation of Rist Act 1 for Rist begins with his captivity in Mage School. He makes friends with fellow students and teachers. He does NOT believe blood magic is ethical. Act 2 begins when Emperor Fane himself shows that 'blood magic is ethical, actually.' Act 2 ends when Rist becomes a Loren battlemage and performs blood magic on a dying elf. Act 3 is the final battle of the war, where Rist participates in a ritual to summon the blood magic god. Dahlen Tries to Stop War in the Dwarven Realms Act 1: the humans are taking refuge with the dwarves. Act 2: assassination attempt! The humans try to leave, but the dwarves won't let them. Army on army combat. Act 3: humans + dwarves fight other dwarves. The good guys prevail. Act 4: This happens at the end of the book. During the peace process, a man everyone thought dead returns and kills everyone, claiming the throne. Calen Crosses the Desert Act 1: Calen + Friends meets druid, who gives them a compass. Act 2: Calen and crew enter the Evil Desert. Using the magic compass, they travel north. Act 3: Fight against weird eldritch horror cat things. Act 4: People go insane due to evil desert magic. Act 5: Successfully cross the desert. Calen Rallies the Alliance of Elves and Men Act 0: Protagonist saves Loren Soldiers and becomes the Warden of Valtyr. Act 1: Calen returns from the desert Act 2: Calen meets the Rakina. Some choose to help him, other choose to ignore him. Act 3: Calen unites the elven kingdoms. He trains. Act 4: Ella returns. Calen discovers that Aeson lied to him. Calen leaves. Act 5: Calen leaves. He goes to the dragon temple, learns about the past from TIvar. Act 6: Blood moon rises. Fight scene. The Rakina who ignored him earlier now help him. Ella Becomes a Druid Act 1: Fight scenes, with hints that Ella's a druid. Act 2: Ella is nearly killed in battle. To survive, she takes control of an owl and attacks the Dragonguard who's killing her. She survives, but is captured. Act 3: Ella escapes captivity with Rist/Justicar help. She flees to Claen, helps in the final battle. Dissent amongst the Dragonguard Act 1: Pelenor helps Calen escape the dungeons. Introduce Tivar. Act 2: Helios and Eltoar try to spare enemy elf draelid. Act 3: Tivar helps save the day Listening to Ascheron Act 1: The Grandmaster hears voices in his head. The voice says it's his patron god Asheron, however the only god who's known to speak to people is Efialtir. Grandmaster uncertain of self. summary:
The Forgetting Moon* Audio book so spelling is guesswork

Characters: Shorecroft, Hawkwood, Spiderwood, Nail, Stefon Waylan, Dokie Little, Zayn Nevil, Aeros rajel, Ava Shay, Jenko Brook, Jondralyn Bronachel, Tala Bronachel, Bourdan Bronachel, Roguemoor, Glade Chaperal, Lindhold Legraven, Lorie Legraven

Things: Laijon, Raijel, Brethren of Mir, Ethic Shroud, Forgetting Moon, Blackest Heart, Lonesome Crown, Afflicted Fire, Angel Stones

Story: Prologue with man named Shorecroft rescuing a small infant boy from two Bloodwood assassins, Hawk and Spider

Cut to a 17 year old boy Nail who lives with Shorecroft in the town of Gallow’s Haven. Small town where many people make a living hunting blue whale-esque beasts called Greakan’s. He is friends with Stefon Waylan, Dokie Little, and Zayn Nevil. They, like all young men, are required to enroll in 2 years of mandatory military training. Made clear early on that the church (In this country, Gul Kana, the last kingdom in The Five Isles not yet conquered by The White Prince, Aeros Rajel, of Sør Sevier) is very important and influential. They believe in Laijon as opposed to the “other side” who believe in Raijel who is Laijon’s earthly son or something like that (he has living descendants supposedly). Nail is a bastard who doesn’t know who his parents are, is in love with Ava Shay and bullied by Jenko Brook, son of the local baron. He feels like a bit of an outcast.

Our second story line is in the castle at the heart of Gul Kana, Amyidon, where we follow the POV’s of Princesses Jondralyn and Tala Bronachel, their father, Bourdan, was killed a number of years ago leaving their eldest brother Giovan king. He is unprepared and begins to fall under the influence of the Quorum of 5 archbishops, basically being a pawn to the church and taking out his anger and stress on those around him. Jondralyn wants to become a warrior, and also gets inducted to a secret organization The Brethren of Mir. Her, a dwarf Roguemoor, and an-ex assassin Hawkwood are co-conspirators.

Meanwhile Tala is pursued by a Bloodwood assassin somewhere in the walls of the castle while sneaking about the secret ways. Her, her “betrothed” Glade Chaperal, and her cousin Lindholf Legraven all flitz about.

On the other team, we see Gault Ailbrek stray away from his prince Aeros Raijel. Both sides are hunting for the weapons of the Five warrior angels. Ethic Shroud (Shield), Forgetting Moon (Battleaxe), Blackest Heart (Crossbow), Lonesome Crown (Helmet), Afflicted Fire (Sword), and the Angel Stones with them.

The armies of Sor Sevier invade Gul Kana, hitting Gallow’s Haven first. Shorecroft dies saving Nail and his buds.

title: Ariadne
author: Jennifer Saint
summary:
Ariandne - Jennifer Saint

Characters: Ariadne, Phaedra, Pasiphae, Minos, Theseus, Deucalion, Dyonisus, Hyppolotus, Perseus, Daedalus, Icarus, Astarion (Minotaur)

Places: Crete, Knossos, Naxos, Athens, Argos

Things: The Labyrinth,

Story: Ariadne takes place in ancient Greece, on the island of Crete. Crete is ruled by the ruthless and tyrannical King Minos, and the novel opens with the story of his conquest of the kingdom of Megara. He kills its king, Nisus, when Nisus’s daughter, Scylla, falls in love with Minos and divulges the secret to her father’s defeat. In the wake of Minos’s victory, however, Minos ties Scylla to the back of his boat and drowns her as punishment for betraying her father. He goes on to wage war on the city of Athens, and the god Zeus aids him in his conquest by sending a devastating plague across the city. Athens has no choice but to accept King Minos’s demands; they must send seven young men and seven young women every year as sacrifices to a creature living in a labyrinth beneath the palace of Knossos in Crete.

Ariadne is the daughter of King Minos and half sister to this creature—the legendary Minotaur. She recounts the story of how the Minotaur came to be: Poseidon, god of the sea, sends King Minos a sacred bull to sacrifice in his honor. Minos’s decision to keep the bull rather than sacrifice it insults Poseidon, who afflicts Minos’s wife, Pasiphae, with lust for the sacred bull. She enlists the palace’s inventor, Daedalus, to construct a realistic wooden cow for her to hide within to trick the bull into mounting her, and she becomes pregnant with its child. This humbles King Minos and brings shame and scandal upon the whole family.

Pasiphae shrinks away in shame during her pregnancy and gives birth when Ariadne is 10 years old. The child is part human, part bull, and Pasiphae names him Asterion. Ariadne does not view the creature with revulsion but rather sees him as her brother and hopes he could be “civilized” one day. She and Pasiphae care for him, but as he grows and becomes harder to contain, Daedalus constructs a labyrinth beneath the palace to house him. The creature lives isolated beneath the palace, feeding on the 14 youths from Athens once a year.

When Ariadne is 18, hostages from Athens arrive. She and her sister, Phaedra, immediately take notice of Theseus, the prince of Athens who has volunteered as a sacrifice to the Minotaur. The sisters are infatuated with him, and Ariadne seeks Daedalus’s help to guide him safely through the Labyrinth, though she betrays her family in doing so. Daedalus gives her a ball of red twine. Ariadne gives Theseus the twine and instructs him on how to navigate the Labyrinth; in exchange, Theseus promises that he will help Ariadne and Phaedra escape from Crete and that he and Ariadne will marry. Theseus successfully defeats the Minotaur and guides all the hostages out of the Labyrinth unharmed. Ariadne escapes with him, leaving Phaedra behind on Crete. They sail to the deserted island of Naxos, but the morning after their arrival, Ariadne wakes to find Theseus has abandoned her on the island.

In the wake of the Minotaur’s defeat, Phaedra witnesses Daedalus escape the palace using wings he constructed. The news of both Theseus’s and Daedalus’s escapes reaches King Minos, and he immediately sets off to find his inventor. His son, Deucalion, arrives to rule in his stead and brings Phaedra news of Ariadne, provided to him by Theseus: He tells her the goddess Artemis killed her in her sleep. To improve relations with Athens, Deucalion has arranged for Phaedra to marry its king—Theseus, who now rules in the wake of his father’s death. Phaedra does not trust Theseus’s account. Still, she takes on an active role as queen of Athens and marries Theseus when she comes of age, becoming pregnant with his child.

Meanwhile, Ariadne is saved when Dionysus, god of wine, arrives on Naxos. He treats Ariadne kindly and names her guardian of his island whenever he is traveling. He returns from one of his travels to bring news of Phaedra: She is safe and betrothed to a great prince. Ariadne and Dionysus develop a relationship, and Ariadne is comforted by the knowledge that Dionysus has a gentler nature than other gods or great heroes. Young women, called “maenads,” flock to the island to worship Dionysus and seek freedom from the oppressive men in their lives. Ariadne and Dionysus marry, and she bears him five sons.

Eventually, Phaedra discovers the truth about her sister’s fate and her marriage to Dionysus, but the birth of her son prevents her from traveling to Naxos. She despises motherhood and resents that her child resembles Theseus. When she gives birth to her second son, she experiences the same lack of maternal feeling.

Ariadne has a much easier time adjusting to motherhood, and life is peaceful until she realizes that her husband’s rituals with the maenads have taken a macabre turn; she catches the young women washing blood out of their robes. Before she can ask about this, she notices a ship arriving from Athens: Phaedra has come. The sisters reunite, and Phaedra tells Ariadne everything that has happened outside of Naxos. She talks about Hippolytus, Theseus’s son by an Amazonian princess, who came to live with them in Athens. Phaedra has fallen in love with him, but Ariadne warns her that she risks scandal if she reveals her feelings. Phaedra gets defensive and promptly leaves Naxos.

Dionysus returns from his travels, perturbed by his mortal half brother Perseus’s refusal to allow his worship in the city of Argos. Ariadne soon finds that his rituals involve sacrificing animals so Dionysus can bring them back to life, and this horrifies her. She sails to Athens to see Phaedra again and deter her from acting on her feelings for Hippolytus.

Phaedra greets Ariadne but still plans to confess her feelings to Hippolytus. She speaks to him while Theseus is away, but he rebuffs her advances. Humiliated and fearing he will tell Theseus, Phaedra hangs herself. Theseus returns, and he and Ariadne run into each other. The two of them find Phaedra’s body and a note with Hippolytus’s name on it, and Theseus assumes Phaedra died by suicide because Hippolytus raped her. He calls upon Poseidon to avenge her, and Hippolytus is killed.

Ariadne returns to Naxos and to Dionysus. They set sail for Argos so Dionysus can confront Perseus. Dionysus, desperate to gain the city’s worship, brings a frenzy upon all the women of Argos. To demonstrate his power over life and death, he has them kill their own babies. The city immediately prepares to fight. Ariadne charges straight for Perseus to ask him to leave Naxos alone, but upon his shield is the head of Medusa, whose gaze turns onlookers to stone, and Ariadne locks eyes with it and is petrified. A grieving Dionysus turns her into a star in the night sky, makes peace with Perseus, and leaves the island of Naxos to women and children only. Ariadne listens to the prayers of women, and her sons go on to lead quiet, peaceful lives.

The attack is partly ended by Bird walking through and killing a ton with his bow. Frost Wyverns retreat, but then everyone freaks out because an Antinium is in Pallass. This causes The Free Queen to receive many messages and raises her standing, and Erin punishes Bird but Numbtongue hangs out with him.

Wall Lord Ilvriss of Salaszar uses the Bird incident to start his secret Necromancy plan, covered by the antinium. We learn that Manus has an actual dragon in it, Rafaema.

We jump over to Pebblesnatch and the Goblin colony in Riverfarm. Emperor Laken is trying to make the Goblins have society and pebblesnatch leads it by introducing good cooking and food.Uvama the shaman makes friends with her kind of.

Fals informs many in Celum that the inn is back. Celum has been getting angier and angrier with Erin being better than them, and Octavia making baking powder upsets bakers. Taking The Players of Celum also upsets them and they want to take the door. Mrsha, is with Krshia and Elirr, and her friends when she meets the criminal gnoll Bearclaw on accident. Then after ruining a cake discovers erin’s Garden of Sanctuary

Wailant Strongheart, Garia’s father, finds Numbtongue in Celum and gets kicked out with him, they travel back to his farm.

Celum wants to take Erin’s door, then realize they need her, but she is angry so takes the players and Octavia. We learn Bearclaw is planning to steal the door, mrsha, and Erin.

Lots of King chapters. The Empress of Sands has lots of heads. King raelt of Jelcrass is trying to handle the chaos of the world. He meets Flos Reimarch, King of Destruction on his borders. Flos has many people coming to him, newly Gnolls and Lizardfold, along with Half-Giants.

We see Trey Atwood, Travel with The Quarass, and Gazi Pathfinder to another Shield Kingdom, A’ctelios Salash. It is called the Carven city and is made in some sort of dead Eldritch horror that is massive. You can’t eat their food or something bad happens. The leaders of the shield kingdoms meet and Gazi gets her eye fixed. Then Trey realizes that the “Pack Animals” are actually transformed humans who ate the food, and many are from Earth. He attacks and then Gazi kills the leader of the city, Baosar. His son Athal and many others attack the 3. They barely escape but obviously the city is angry and declares war.

TV is being more and more introduced to the world. Flos meets with his new subjects but feel like something is missing. Teresa Atwood talks to Nawalishifra, the Nouhousin Blacksmith, and Zamea, leader of the half-giants. Jecaina, raelts daughter, challenges Mars the Illusionist to a duel and loses badly. Rustängmarder, are an elite unit of death soldiers. Flos rides into Belchan to search for his missing people.

Wistram Academy is always looking to be rude to Flos and after the A’ctelios incident plan to show how he broke his oath, but when they TV over to him he just found his dead subjects, a group of gnolls slaughtered and the children killed and enslaved. Flos goes ferally angry and vows war against Belchan. Since it was televised the world all saw the massacred and Gnolls and Belchan’s people admit they did it, so many side with Flos and attack Belchan.

title: Wintersteel
author: Will Wight
summary:
Wintersteel Cradle #8 Will Wight

People: Wei-Shi Lindon Arelius, Yerin Arelius, Timaias Adama, Subject One, Northstrider, Kiuran, Sha Miara, Reigan shen, akura malice, akura mercy, akura pride, akura grace, Eithan Arelius, AKura Fury, Akura Charity, Sopharanatoth, Ziel, Yan Shoumei, Akura Mercy, Brother Aekin, Calan Archer, Emriss SIlentborn, Tiberian Arelius, Min Shuei, Naru Saeya, Prince Daji, Meira

Places: Sacred Valley, The Labyrinth, Ninecloud City, Redmoon Hall, Abyssal Palace, Seishen Kingdom

Things: Dross, Penance, Abidan, Stormcallers, Frozen Blade School, Wandering Titan, Bleeding Phoenix, Little Blue

Story: Prologue shows us the death of the Sage of the Endless Sword, Timaias Adama, in Sacred Valley. We learn that there is a curse of sorts on sacred valley that makes the sacred arts a lot weaker there, and it is because an entrance to The Labyrinth is hidden there, and the labyrinth contains someone/thing names Subject One, who created the Dreadgods.

We begin right after Wei-Shi Lindon Arelius lost in his bout to Yerin Arelius, making her an uncrowned and him not. Northstrider meets Lindon somewhere else in Ninecloud City, and asks him about Dross. The monarchs discuss the weapon Penance, given by the Abidan Hound, Kiuran. Sha-Miara is secretly a monarch and Reigan Shen is an enemy of Akura malice.

Dross stole a memory from Northstrider and thinks lindon can use his hunger madra arm to consume madra from enemies, helping his advancement.

We see Eithan Arelius use his actual strength for the first time, he reveals he is on the path of the hollow king, and defeats Sha Miara, a hidden Monarch, in 9 seconds. Sopharanatoth tries to advance and fails, she has pushed herself too far too fast and is permanently damaged unless she wins the tournament.

Lindon and Yerin go on a date, Ziel, Yan Shoumei of Redmoon Hall, Akura Mercy, Brother Aekin of Abyssal Palace, and Calan Archer of the Stormcallers all become uncrowned.

All Uncrowned have a month to train with sages. Eithan goes with the Arelius Clan sage and advances to Overlord instantly, he had just been waiting. Reigan Shen then purchases Eithan to throw the next match. Yerin will go with The winter sage, Min Shuei at the Frozen blade school and works to develop her sage-ness. We get reports on Emriss SIlentborn, and Tiberian Arelius, 2 monarchs, 1 dead.

Meanwhile Lindon goes to a city near the Wandering Titan to help evacuate citizens and stall the enemies of the Akura clan. He goes Akura Fury, who teams him up with Akura Pride, Grace, Naru Saeya, and some others. Once Lindon learns there is a point system and defeating remnants can buy him stuff he goes crazy, and practices consuming essence and begins to gain a ton of power.

The Sheisen Kingdom is also there, and Prince Daji still wants to kill Lindon for killing his brother, Prince Kiro.

Eithan throws his match to Yan Shoumei, Ziel barely loses to Brother Aekin. Eithan buys Ziel’s loyalty by saying he may be able to fix his channels. Mercy and Sophara have a very close battle that mercy ends up losing, disappointing her family.

Eithan, Mercy, Lindon, and Fury go back to the wandering titan battlefield and Lindon combines his Pure Core with a pact with Little Blue, similar to what he did with Dross for Blackflame. Daji is angry as always and tried to attack a tower but Lindon was there first, Meira, restrains Daji so Lindon won’t kill him but Daji is very angry.

Yerin discovers her Overlord revelation is that “I am not him” referring to the sword sage. Yerin and Sophara both win their matches and are the final 2. Yerin receives a Moonlight Bridge, allowing her to teleport anywhere on a slight cooldown. Ruby, Yerin’s blood shadow, uses it to teleport herself to Lindon and hang out.

Reigan shen grabs the other uncrowned that lost and tells them he will send them with The Blood Sage to kills Pride and Mercy when they are alone.

Sophara wins the first 2 matches, but then Yerin advances to herald by combining with Ruby. Together they are infinitely more powerful, and the first ever overlord herald. Yerin slaughter Sophara easily. The tournament is over and chaos starts.

Fury has been taunting all of the enemy heralds, and now that Yerin won he attacks them, using the strength icon of a sage, meaning he is becoming a monarch. The 4 monarchs in Ninecloud city also begin battling each other. Reigan shen also starts his assassination plan on Mercy and Pride. Lindon sees the assassin’s appear but is too far away and they teleport off, but Eithan slips into the group before they leave. Lindond has to go force open the portal left by the sage, which should not be possible but he does with Eithan’s help from the other side. Eithan is an Archlord now thanks to Reigan Shen’s resources.

While Eithan distracts the blood sage, Lindon easily tears through and kills the remaining uncrowned assassin’s and 2 overlords. Akura grace and 2 others are already dead though. Pride and Naru Saeya barely live. Lindon finishes by battling Sophara and manifesting the Void Icon, making him a sage.

Yerin uses penance on the Dragon King, Seshethkunaaz, and he just dies. Eithan gives lindon a wintersteel unsouled badge, marking him as a sage.

Orthos helped wei-Shi Kelsa, lindon’s sister, advance to Jade back in Sacred Valley, and then finds Jai-Long and says he needs his help for a mission.

title: Daggerspell
author: Katherine Kerr
summary:
Daggerspell Deverry #1 Katherine Kerr

We start out with an interesting story following people we know and then it jumps somewhere completely else but you realize it is the same “souls” just in a past incarnation explaining why they are intertwined now. Fairly interesting for the 80’s I guess but pretty boring honestly.

Year 1045 The sorcerer Nevyn sees an omen indicating that a person whose destiny is intertwined with his own has been reborn, and sees the infant Jill in a vision.

Year 1052 Jill, a seven-year-old girl who sometimes has precognitive dreams, loses her mother Seryan to a fever. Because her father, Cullyn, is a mercenary soldier – known as a "silver dagger" for the weapon he carries – and visits irregularly, Jill is taken in by a local tavern owner. Cullyn arrives in Jill's village a month later. Finding Seryan dead, he decides to take Jill with him on his wanderings, which he calls "the long road.”

For seven years, Nevyn has been searching for Jill, with nothing more than luck and intuition to guide him. He finds a clue when he meets the ten-year-old lord Rhodry Maelwaedd, and sees that the boy's destiny is linked with his and Jill's.

Year 643 Galrion, a prince of Deverry, has secretly begun studying sorcery. He begins to fall in love with its power, and out of love with his betrothed, Brangwen of the Falcon clan. Galrion considers breaking his betrothal so that he will have more time to devote to the study of sorcery. Galrion's father, King Adoryc, is infuriated when he discovers that his son has been studying sorcery, and puts Galrion under house arrest, though the prince escapes by a ruse.

Adoryc soon finds his son and sends him into exile, taking from him all his rank, titles, and property. He even takes Galrion's name from him, and gives him a new name, Nevyn, meaning "no one." Adoryc also breaks Nevyn's betrothal to Brangwen, who then falls into an incestuous relationship with her brother Gerraent, and the two promise to end their lives together when autumn comes.

When Gerraent's sworn friend, Blaen of the Boar clan, discovers the incestuous relationship, Gerraent kills him. Gerraent is in turn killed by Blaen's brother. Nevyn takes Brangwen away from the Falcon lands, but the distraught girl drowns herself. Overwhelmed by guilt and grief, Nevyn rashly swears an oath that he will not rest until he sets things right. Thunder booms from a clear sky – a sign that his oath has been accepted by the Great Ones (transcendent spiritual beings similar to Bodhisattvas).

Year 1058 When Jill turns thirteen, Cullyn, who has been teaching his daughter swordcraft, buys Jill a silver dagger like his own for a birthday present. Otho, the smith who made the dagger, notices that Jill can see spirits called Wildfolk, and tells her a riddle. "If you ever find no one (nev yn), ask him what craft to take." Some time later, Otho tells Nevyn about Jill. Unable to find her, Nevyn returns to his home province of Eldidd, where he saves the life of Rhodry Maelwaedd, earning the gratitude of his mother Lovyan, the local feudal lord. Nevyn receives a prophecy about the boy – Rhodry's destiny is somehow bound to that of the entire province.

Year 696 Nevyn comes to Deverry province to banish an unnatural drought. Here he finds the bard Gweran (Blaen reborn), his wife Lyssa (Brangwen reborn), and a soldier called Tanyc (Gerraent reborn). When Tanyc angers Gweran by his behavior towards Lyssa, Gweran takes his revenge by subterfuge. He provokes Tanyc into attacking him – but as a bard, Gweran's life is sacrosanct. Tanyc is hanged for his crime.

While this is happening, Nevyn meets Lyssa's elder son, Aderyn. He teaches the boy a little herbcraft, and eventually takes him as apprentice in sorcery.

Year 1062 Lovyan discovers that Rhodry has fathered a bastard child on a low-born girl, and decides to put the child into fosterage with one of her noble servitors when it is born. In the meantime, Lovyan is having trouble with some of her vassals. A number of minor lords are sitting on the edge of rebellion over matters of succession and taxes. Lovyan's own liege lord, Rhys, the Gwerbret of Aberwyn (who is also her eldest son), makes it very clear that he won't intervene unless she disinherits Rhodry.

Cullyn, meanwhile has taken a hire guarding a caravan heading toward the kingdom's western border to trade with the mysterious Westfolk. On the way, Jill sees the eerie Loddlaen, a councilor to Lord Corbyn of Bruddlyn. At the trading camp, Jill meets Aderyn, an old Deverrian man who lives with the Westfolk. She also learns that Loddlaen is a fugitive murderer. At the conclusion of the trading, Aderyn and several of the Westfolk accompany the caravan back to the city of Cannobaen, to begin legal proceedings against Loddlaen in Lovyan's court.

On the way to Cannobaen, the caravan is attacked by bandits, and flees to an abandoned fort to make their stand. Aderyn transforms himself into an owl to spy on the bandits. He discovers that they aren't bandits at all, but warriors from several different lords, including Corbyn. Cullyn sends Jill to beg the Lovyan for aid. By a stroke of luck, Jill comes across Rhodry and his entire warband on the road, in the midst of a day-long training exercise.

Meanwhile, the attacking army has reached the fort. The defense is thin: two swordsmen, two archers, and six stavemen. Albaral, a man of the Westfolk, is slain, but the attackers are defeated when Rhodry and his warband arrive.
