Then they all choose to fall asleep on the plane instead of doing anything rational and Thomas wakes up in a padded cell alone with Theresa saying he has been gone for a week.

title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
summary:
Project Hail Mary Andy Weir

Man wakes up from coma in a small medical looking room with amnesia. Hard for him to walk / move much, robot was taking care of him. 2 dead people in bunks nearby. Slowly explores small area, trying to figure out what is going on and remember life. Memories start coming back, he is Dr. Ryland Grace, a Jr. high science teacher who likes space. He realizes via some tests in a lab that gravity is not correct. Concludes he must not be on Earth. More memories come back. Earth’s sun Sol was dying from some mysterious light stealing it’s energy. He gets called in to investigate the sample taken because of what he wrote his doctorate thesis on. Discovers a single celled alien life form. Astrophage.

In the present, he is in a space ship. He realizes he is by the star Tau Ceti, which for some reason is unaffected by Astrophage. He needs to figure out why.

After experimenting with Astrophage on Earth he learns how to duplicate them. Very important so that more people can test them. He is now important. Dr. Stratt is the lady basically in charge of the world since she is the lead for “Project Hail Mary”. They want to send a team to Tau Ceti to investigate and send back the results via small beetle ships. It is a suicide mission. The entire world is working on this.

Suddenly Grace sees another spaceship super close to his. It seems friendly. It sends over a container with little diagrams of their ships, then after confirmation makes a tunnel to connect them.

Project Hail Mary recruits the best minds on Earth. The biggest problem is they need to put the crew into coma’s and only 1/7000 are able to not die in a coma. The ship will be powered by Astrophage, so they pave the Sahara to breed them. It takes 13 years to get to Tau ceti (+ 13 back) so Earth needs to live for that long. But it isn’t supposed to so they nuke Antartica to create more greenhouse gasses.

Grace meets and Alien rock-spider like creature through a wall. Via numbers and elements they begin to learn to communicate. The aliens speak via musical notes. Alien is dubbed Rocky. Rocky and Grace begin to exchange more and more information about themselves, their species, worlds, and science. Rocky is also here to try to save his planet from Astrophage.

Eventually they can speak fluently and Rocky (an incredible engineer with an eidetic memory) moves into the Hail Mary after creating Xenonite walls since his atmosphere is 29x, hot, and ammonia. They figure out their must be a predator of Astrophage on the nearby planet. They jerryrig a solution and both almost die and hurt the ship, but they get it. They have to do selective breeding to make it immune to nitrogen so that it can save their planets. Also because Rocky ship has extra Astrophage no longer a suicide mission for Grace.

Flashback: 9 days before launch an explosion happens and the 2 scientists who were supposed to go on this mission die. Grace has to be the one. He says no. Stratt imprisons him and says she will feed him an amnesia medicine so he don’t remember this when he wakes up. It worked.

Rocky and Grace successfully have the “Taumeba” predator they need to save Earth and Arid. They part ways. Grace realizes Taumeba also evolved to escape Xenonite, so he is fune but Rocky will be in trouble. He sends the beetles and goes to save Rocky, his friend. Together they return to Arid where a Earth-dome is constructed and Grace lives happily, teaching young Iridians science.

title: The Kill Order
author: James Dashner
summary:
The Kill Order James Dashner The Maze Runner #0.5

Mark and Trina are dating and living in the woods with Alec and Lana (retired soldiers), as well as Misty, The Toad, and Darnell. This is a post sun-flares world where they are starting to figure out how to survive. Then a big Berg flys in and people shoot darts at them. Those hit either die or go crazy. Mark and Alec hijack the berg and crash it, but learn that the darts had a dangerous disease in them. They march back and all of their friends are sick and dying except Lana and Trina. They explore towards where they think the berg came from. Find a burned out village with a 5 year old girl named DeeDee in it who seems to be immune to the disease. Mark and Alec stumble upon her old village having a bonfire and are captured. These people are crazy, think the sickness is demons. They escape but big fire starts and they can’t find their friends. Go to where the Berg came from and hear them say the disease was released intentionally to cull the population. Then they have to run because the people at this facility are starting to go crazy from the sickness. They steal a berg and leave. Those crazy people think that Asheviulle (nearby) has a Flat-Trans (teleporter) to Alaska, where the PFC (post-F;ares Coalition) is headed up.

They find weapons called transvices on board. They are like ray guns, dissolve whoever they hit. Mark feels like he has the disease and is starting to go crazy. They hunt down their friends who were captured by DeeDee crazy villagers in an old rich neighborhood. They use the guns to work their way though, when they eventually see LAna being dragged out of a house and beaten. They fight and kill the attackers but she is so hurt and damaged Alex kills her out of mercy. In the house they find Lana and Trina but their are too many crazies (Cranks). Mark loses his transvice and they all jump out a window and run back to the berg. Trina does not recognize Mark and is clearly far gone with the disease.

Oh meanwhile we have gotten periodic flashbacks. Mark and Trina were childhood neighbors, Mark always had ac rush on her. They were in a subway so survived the sun flares. Alec saved them in the tunnels and took them to the rest of the gang. They escaped a flood and survived in the Lincoln buiding for a but., Then some bad guys on a boat showed up and killed a young kid, Baxter, that had been with theme. Alec kills the bad guy and they steal the boat and leave. Survive and caves and stuffi n the Appalachians until they find the settlement where the story starte, and Mark and Trina fell in love over that time.

Alec wakes up Mark and is clearly about to lose it. He wants to die. Mark has a plan. He Writes a not saying deedee is immune and they fly into Asheville to use the flat trans. They see Bruce and the facility disease people breaking in. They fly to the middle and get off, Mark is losing it more and more. They send DeeDee through the teleporter and then as Bruce and thec razues all close in, Alec crashes the berg into the building. Killing everyone and destroying the flat trans. Right before the end Trina recognizes Mark and they kiss.

We get a post-credits of Theres (DeeDee) and Thomas meeting at the Wicked facility in Alsaka.

title: The Gate of the Feral Gods
author: Matt Dinniman
summary:
The Gate of the Farl Gods Matt DInniman DCC #4

Essentially the main thing that happened at the end that has the biggest influence on the next book was Kati’s discussed leaving the party. Then Carl opened the gate and flooded the city of larracos on the 9th floor which made a lot of people mad. They teased the bea and Ferdinand would be brought into the game.

Maggie Mai is dead, Rock Man Chris has joined the party temporarily. They have hired a Demigod/Feral God imprisoned in the head of a sex doll as their new trainer. Carl is using the Anarchist Cookbook as a guide to attack the MudSkippers. Carl has killed 1 admin and gotten away with it. Carl's second sponsor is REALLY wealthy and investing big on him. There was a epilogue conversation within this group implying that thier real purpose is in line with Carl's. The next floor is the first with outsiders coming en masse to hunt crawlers, and Carl finished the book taunting them all.

title: The Butcher's Masquerade
author: Matt Dinniman
summary:
The Butcher's Masquerade Matt Dinniman Dungeon Crawler Carl #5

They do some dumb stuff and get lucky.

The team enters the sixth floor, "the Hunting Grounds." Carl meets with Orren, who tells him that Borant wants him to voluntarily give up the Gate of the Feral Gods until level 9. Carl asks for a lawyer. Donut's new class on this floor is Legendary Diva. Carl picks the Agent Provocateur class upgrade. 2 Carl joins Donut and Katia in a dryad settlement. Mordecai is now an adorable pocket kuma. 3 Carl's new lawyer, Quasar, arrives. Quasar bargains for Carl to give up the Gate temporarily in exchange for four free mercenaries (Bomo, the Sledge, Clay-ton, and Very Sullen) and two spells given to Bomo and the Sledge to replicate two of the gate's abilities: teleport to stairwell and zerzura. 4 Donut is a terrible singer, so her spells are useless. The team prepares for the release of the hunters. Bomo teleports Carl and Donut to the stairwell in Zockau. 5 Carl attacks the hunters in Zockau and uses his Ring of Divine Suffering to mark hunters, kill them, and gain stats. His explosives cause massive destruction and trap many hunters in the Desperado Club. Carl is injured as the party escapes, and is rescued by Miriam Dom and Prepotente. 6 Miriam Dom is a vampire now. Mordecai warns against using the Ring of Divine Suffering, saying it is addictive. Zev reminds Carl that his contract with the Vengeance of the Daughter program is still in effect. 7 The team reaches a small bugbear settlement and says goodbye to Miriam and Prepotente. Mordecai reprimands Carl for blowing up Zockau. 8 Carl opens his boxes and receives a claw from each hunter killed, which can be exchanged for prizes later. He also receives a new tattoo: The Night Wyrm's Nasty Little Web of Suffering. The team watches the recap episode and learns that the guild system will be going live, allowing them to form larger alliances without being in the same party. There will be a party at the end of this floor called the Butcher's Masquerade, with invites for the top 50 crawlers. 9 The team heads south, away from Zockau, and Carl asks Katia to organize knocking down various bridges. Carl plans to have Bomo carry a large bomb out of the safe room into Zockau to cause further destruction. Donut convinces him to let her try to use a clockwork Bomo instead. 10 Carl and Donut continue traveling towards the river and approach a settlement across a bridge. The settlement has many rules and won't let Mongo in, so Donut kills the mayor and becomes Mayor herself. Carl tries to send Bomo into Zockau with the bomb, but stops when he finds a note on the door from Vrah which tells him that the hunters in Zockau are now protected from explosives and that the Hive is hunting him. The hunters are released. 11 Katia and Carl discuss starting a guild. The team receives the Recital quest to look into the dinosaur attacks on the town, newly named Point Mongo by Donut. Mongo suddenly runs off with Donut on his back and finds a pack of dinosaurs. He mates with Kiwi, the head of the all-female mongoliensis pack. 12 Carl confronts Donut about her risky behavior (following Mongo into danger) and she reveals that she is afraid everyone will leave her. Zev interrupts their conversation and gives them a schedule update for their next appearance on Odette's show. Carl promises Donut that he will include her in his plans in the future and that nothing is going to break up their team. 13 Quasar continues negotiations with Borant for two additional items in the exchange for Carl giving up the Gate, one of which is to extend a secondary program license to Vengeance of the Daughter. Tsarina Signet and her team show up, including some were-kin allies led by Clint Smashgrab. 14 Donut notices that Signet repels water. Signet says it is not a spell but a curse. Carl and Donut follow Signet to meet up with additional allies including Miss Nadine, a bearded sage Caterpillar. Signet explains to the group that her father, the high elf king, is dead and her half-sister Queen Imogen rules the high elves now, and that her Naiad mother was killed by the Confederacy, a group of Naiad dissenters. She has gathered allies together to defeat the Confederacy and the High Elves. 15 The group kills a hunter from The Dream and Carl loots an Arrow of Enthusiastic Double Gonorrhea from his body, as well as a crude map of the hunting grounds with territories claimed by each hunting group. Carl and Donut had been claimed by The Hive and Skull Empire. 16 Clint tells Carl and Donut about Scolopendra's attack and says the high elves were protected by something they had stolen. The group heads back to Point Mongo. Carl and Donut receive their third and final sponsor, The Apothecary. 17 Carl and Donut return to the saferoom. Samantha is screaming because she wants to be taken to Signet, who she claims can help her get her body back. Carl tells her they will bring her if she shuts up. Carl and Donut are transferred for their appearance on Odette's show. Before the show, Zev and Odette reveal that Bea is alive. 18 Odette explains that Bea survived the initial collection and that Odette had her taken away to prevent Borant from using her in the crawl as a country boss. She wasn't going to tell Carl and Donut, but another program found out and planned to ambush them with the information. She says that Carl might understand her motivation better if he asks Mordecai for the story about what Odette did to him. Carl and Donut agree to talk to Bea on Odette's show. 19 Odette shares the cover story that pirates tried to sell Bea to Borant and they turned the pirates over to the authorities. Bea answers some questions but has clearly been drugged and is confused. Donut confronts Bea about her plan to abandon Donut, and shares additional choice words with Bea once they are off the air. Suddenly, a planet-wide message plays, stating that the Borant Corporation has been declared an independent entity from the Borant government, and that the Valtay Corporation was granted 51% ownership of the Borant Corporation. Donut, Zev, and Odette seem to have had a hand in this turn of events, but Carl is out of the loop. 20 Carl starts to ask Donut about her involvement, but stops because it is too risky to discuss. Lexus, speaking for Odette, tells Carl and Donut that Queen Imogen will likely be a repurposed human, but she is not sure who now that Bea is out of the picture, and that she will be a country boss meant to zero out the top crawlers at the Butcher's Masquerade. Donut mentions that she "smuggled all those Valtay secret agent guys to Zev and the Borant Emancipation Front." Carl and Donut are transferred back to the personal space. Imani agrees to be the guildmaster for the group. 21 An announcement says that hunters can no longer communicate with the outside. Carl finds out he has received a fan booth at CrawlCon. Katia finally leaves the party. The party joins the Safehome Yolanda guild. 22 Elves attack. Carl uses Samantha to deliver missiles. Carl gives a bad guy soliloquy and kills another hunter from The Dream. 23 Carl's ring levels up. Donut gets a bracelet that gives her the fireball spell. Samantha is getting stronger and more capable. 24 Carl, Donut and Samantha head out to meet Signet to attack Fort Freedom, the former naiad palace. 25 Samantha asks Signet to give her her body. Signet declines but offers to help Samantha recover her body after the naiads and elves are dealt with. Signet's forces gather on both shores around the submerged castle. Katia messages the team to say that Langley's team has fallen to Vrah. Carl sends Samantha into the castle as a distraction to draw all the guards to the front door. 26 With Samantha distracting the guards, Signet and her team enter through the backdoor via the river to attack the Confederacy in the throne room. Carl and Donut wait on the shore. They learn from Areson that Signet's dispel-water curse was cast on her by the high elves who helped dissenters kill the Naiad Tsar. Naiad bodies start to float up in the river and Carl asks Samantha what is going on in the throne room. He calls Samantha back right as she says "I've almost got him." 27 Claude the river monster (borough boss!) appears in front of Carl and Donut, having just swallowed Samantha. He had taken over the throne room from the Confederacy. Fighting ensues, and the team kills Claude. Miss Nadine is killed in the battle. 28 The team experiences premature questjaculation. Carl sends Samantha to the opposite shore to do some recon. She reports that the team from that side is all dead, having been killed by Big Tina. The Recital quest is updated, revealing that Big Tina the dinosaur is responsible for the attacks on Point Mongo. Signet and team return. Carl and Donut achieve completion of the Vengeance of the Daughter Part 1 and receive Part 2: kill Signet's half-sister, Queen Imogen of the high elves. She will be present at the Butcher's Masquerade party at the end of this floor. The reward allows the party to loot the high elf castle, which may contain an item that can protect one from Scolopendra's attacks. 29 Edgar the tortoise gives Signet a new tattoo of Miss Nadine using her dead body. Miss Nadine's connection to Clint causes her to bring him with her and he also appears as a tattoo. Carl and team split from Signet and travel to the next village, Alucarda, grinding along the way, aiming to reach the safe room before his appointment at CrawlCon. Zev sends them a few messages urging them to reach the saferoom quickly. As they arrive in the village, they learn that the mayor is none other than Lucia Mar, who appears behind them just outside the safe room as Carl is transported away. 30 Carl talks to Zev in the production trailer and finds out he won't be sent back to Donut until after his second event. Zev tells him that others may be waiting for him when he is transferred back. 31 Carl judges a children's drawing contest. He finds out his panel discussion will be moderated by the mother of one of the hunters he killed. 32 Zev tells Carl about Circe Took, a mantis and mother of Xindy (killed by Carl) and Vrah. Zev says Donut is ok but can't give any more details. Carl gets access to the Ultimate Training Room for the next four hours. Carl is taken to the panel discussion. 33 Carl meets Uptown Hal, Sydnee, and Drick. Carl and Circe argue, and Carl gets more and more aggressive. Circe tries to cut Carl off, but a mysterious cloaked woman in the back corner stops her. Carl realizes he has been drugged by his guards, making him lose his inhibitions. The robed woman reveals that she is one of Carl's sponsors and leaves. Circe storms out. Carl crowd sources a plan to kill Vrah. 34 Carl prepares to be transported. The team tells him that Lucia Mar is waiting in the safe room with teleport traps, Donut is in the guild hall, a bunch of hunters are waiting outside, and Samantha was taken by Vrah and attached to her back with her collection of heads. 35 Fighting ensues. Carl reveals that he had his own plan, and the one discussed at the panel was a decoy since he knew some hunters were still communicating with the outside. The team avoids Lucia's teleportation traps and Carl kills a bunch of hunters, gaining stats via his ring. Carl and Vrah face off, and Carl gives Vrah double gonorreah before escaping into the saferoom. 36 Back in the saferoom, Carl and Donut are joined by Katia and her crew. Katia and Bautista appear to be in a relationship. Donut gets a vocal coach. Carl gets a new Enemy of the Church tattoo for defiling the shrine of Diwata and is advised to steer clear of driads and Diwata herself. Carl also gets new patches and discovers that Donut's Earth hobby skill is knowledge about patches. Carl gets the "swole" upgrade. 37 The team watches the recap episode, which shows Donut's battle with Lucia Mar. Mid-fight, Lucia Mar calls it a draw. She appears to be talking to someone who isn't there, who she says is named Alexandro and is her youth assistant, and rapidly changes between personalities. One of Lucia's dogs, Cici, returns and attacks Donut, but Donut escapes and kills Cici. Back in real time, Bomo arrives with the male mantis Carl had offered to protect from Vrah, who likely sought to pass the gonorrhea on to him as the only remaining mantis. 38 The male mantis is named Edict, and he explains that he is screwed no matter what, then attacks inside the saferoom, getting himself teleported to the nearest mob nest and killed. 39 Carl and Donut grind and take control of two additional towns. They arrive at a third town, Prepotente Town #4, to find it ravaged by Big Tina and head into the saferoom for Carl's final CrawlCon event. 40 Carl joins the Popov brothers at the production facility before the autograph event. Zev tells Carl that his replacement sponsor (Valtay sponsor lost when they gained 51% ownership of Borant Corp.) will be revealed during the event. 41 Carl and the Popov brothers sign autographs and take photos with fans. Carl meets a chapter president of the Princess Posse who advocates for eradication of cocker spaniels and has a head tentacle named Maggie. Carl's new sponsor is The Plenty. Nihit confronts Carl about Odette doing the Bea reveal before he could, and Carl stabs him with a sharpie. 42 Zev informs Carl that Nihit wants to press charges, and that if he survives the crawl he could receive a warrant, which would allow him to be sold as a pseudo-slave. 43 The Plenty and The Apothecary send Carl and Donut items that protect them from vampirism. Miriam Dom messages Carl saying she is trapped and needs help. 44 Miriam is trapped in the aftermath of an elite quest, with Prepotente paralyzed and fragile with his arm around her waist. The party sets out to save her, but finds that Big Tina has returned to the town. They learn that the dinosaurs were originally ursine who were transformed by Scolopendra's attack, and that Big Tina wants to dance at a recital since she never got her chance. Big Tina has also become a vampire and is creating undead minions. 45 Miriam confirms that she spread vampirism to Big Tina and the other dinosaurs. Carl and Donut reach the next town, and Donut draws Mongo's blood for the charm animal potion. 46 Donut kills the mayor and takes the town. They approach Miriam's location only to encounter a boss battle with Sierra, the now-vampiric mount of the elite Viscount Fog. They defeat her and move onward. 47 Carl and Donut find Miriam, and she reveals that in the chaos of their last battle, Prepotente's Ring of Divine Suffering had marked her, meaning he cannot heal while she lives. She also reveals that killing the head vampire (herself) will cure everyone afflicted with vampirism. She asks Carl to kill her before Prepotente's paralysis wears off, and he refuses but waits with her for sunrise instead. 48 Miriam dies and everyone is cured of vampirism. The Creeping Apocalypse world quest is announced. Carl and Donut wake Prepotente and he is distraught, and also eats his Ring of Divine Suffering. 49 Kiwi and her dinosaur posse arrive, and Donut charms her using a potion. Carl realizes that The Plenty set up this chain of events and likely wanted Miriam to die. Prepotente sets out to kill odious creepers and Carl, Donut, and the dino squad head back to the saferoom. 50 Odious creepers start to fall to crawlers. The party catches up with Mordecai and Katia's team, and then heads out to hunt creepers themselves. 51 Donut gets credit for a creeper kill. The party encounters the high elves and the familiar of Queen Imogen, who turns out to be Ferdinand. He attacks Mongo and Donut leaps in front of the blast, only surviving because of her cockroach ability. 52 Carl wants to go down the stairs early to protect Donut, but she convinces him she is okay. Katia tells Carl she needs to talk to him about something important in person. The dinosaur squad returns to Carl and Donut with Big Tina in tow, but Kiwi stops Tina from attacking. The AI announces that they failed the world quest and now all saferoom access is limited by a blood bar which is filled by killing enemies, and the spell Gehenna Bramble will spread outward from the location of the remaining creepers. A hunter with blood bar at zero is immediately teleported to the party's location. 53 Carl talks to hunter Iota, who tells them that the AI is starting to go primal, disobeying court orders. He says it is rumored that the Mantises sold Borant a used AI for this crawl under the table. Carl kills him. 54 Carl and Katia chat and determine that the brambles will cover the entire floor by the last day, ending at the high elf castle. Both parties move in that direction. 55 Signet warns Carl that the dryads may summon Diwata to fight the spreading brambles. Carl gets a potion and cryptic note in his benefactor box from The Open Intellect Pacifist Action Network telling him that Circe had sponsored Diwata and instructing him to give Donut the potion. Carl and Donut get nipple piercings. 56 A flashback reveals that Carl and Quasar planned for him to use the Zerzura spell to transport a full city containing the changelings down to the ninth floor. Back in current events, the countdown to the Butcher's Masquerade begins. Donut's applications for the pet beauty contest and the talent show are accepted. The team goes over the map of the high elf castle together. Prepotente says he want to bring something to Donut. 57 Carl tells Bautista he approves of his relationship with Katia and he seems relieved. Prepotente arrives and gives Donut an "I Take It All Back" potion from his benefactor box. 58 Carl and Donut go to the Desperado Club to try to make contact with the changelings. They blackmail their way onto the hunter floor of the club and tell the changelings that they need to get to the high elf palace during the party for their plan to succeed. 59 Carl and Donut are taken to Orren following their trespassing incident. Orren tells them that he is leaving after the collapse of this floor and won't return until the ninth floor. Donut realizes that Orren is trying to warn them of something. Quasar joins the group along with the woman from Donut's fan club. 60 Back in the saferoom, Carl starts planning to kill as many hunters as possible to reduce their numbers before the party. Zev tells the party that the Syndicate Council ruled that no more lawsuits could be filed naming the AI as defendant, showing its deterioration. The party and their guild allies head out to kill hunters. 61 As the group executes a raid on a church, Carl gets a notification that Diwata has entered the realm, and that he has been marked for death. 62 Diwata runs out of the church and away from the group, surprising them. Samantha tells the group that Diwata is known to give birth to new forest creatures and that the other gods don't like it. They realize she is likely heading to Vrah to cure her of her gonorrhea and potentially give birth to her own grandchildren. 63 The group heads to the next town and find Signet there. Carl speaks to her privately and tells her that her plan to kill Queen Imogen won't work because it is the climax of the main story and that he has an alternative plan. No one in the group can figure out what all the items given to Donut from various other Crawlers' benefactor boxes are for. The team heads out to the party. 64 Carl documents his plan in the cookbook. We see a few pages from the secret bathroom notepad the team has been using to communicate. Their primary goal is to survive the Butcher's Masquerade, with secondary goals to complete the Tina quest, kill Eva, save the changelings, take the castle, kill Lucia Mar, and kill every hunter. Carl, Donut and crew are escorted to the party. They have Britney with them, as well as a changeling disguised as Signet. Suddenly, Queen Imogen appears in their carriage. 65 Queen Imogen is revealed to be Ifechi's twin sister. She confronts Carl about bringing Signet along, and tells him that as host, it is her duty to ensure there is no violence this evening and if she succeeds, she receives a boon from Apito. She says that the party is under a celestial peace seal, and anyone who breaks the peace will be fed into the Nothing. 66 Carl messages the group with a new plan, saying that they can't be the ones to make the first move. A guard tells the changeling Signet that she is unwelcome, and she leaves, presumably as part of the plan. The rest of the party goes through security and enters Ballroom A. Chaco is manning the prize counter, and Princess (now Empress) D'Nadia is judging the talent show and pet contest. Donut heads backstage to prepare, and D'Nadia tells Carl that he and his attorney almost ruined her buy-in bid. Vrah enters the party. 67 Vrah tells Carl that she has a present for him. Lucia Mar and Eva arrive, and various crawlers have to be held back from attacking them. Florin and Carl agree that something is off with Lucia. Prepotente tells Carl he needs to join their party for the remainder of this floor so that they travel together to the next floor but Carl is hesitant. The official party activities begin, and Carl's allies outside the castle start to move. Signet enters the room, which was not a part of the plan. 68 Apito invited Signet to the party to test Imogen. Signet says no one has ever gotten the boon from Apito. 69 Carl asks Chaco why Mordecai hates him, but he isn't allowed to say what happened. Carl browses the prizes and talks to Mordecai about them via the chat. Mordecai asks about the memorial crystal, which costs 100 hands, and Chaco says it is the Queen's most prized possession. Carl picks his prizes: a shrink wand, the 8th floor lore book, a music sheet of skedaddle, featherfall potions, and healing potions. 70 The group watches Mongo's performance in the pet show. Bomo and the Sledge report that baby mantises are everywhere outside the castle. Mordecai says that Diwata's birthing is a spell, and she will stay on the floor until it is done casting regardless of the 5 minute limit. 71 Florin comforts Lucia and tells the group that there are multiple in Lucia's head, including other children, and that the dog is key to whatever is going on. Ferdinand shows up. 72 Donut uses her enhanced charisma to charm Ferdinand, and he decides to go through the ducts to be physically in the crawlers' ballroom. Samantha also travels the ducts to reach the control room and finds that the guards are already dead. Queen Imogen appears in the ballroom, sealing everyone in the party inside. 73 Imogen was previously outside fighting, and killed some of Carl's allies. She confronts Carl and Signet, but cannot do anything to harm them. The talent show proceeds. A group of hunters including Vrah has surrounded Lucia and it looks like they are trying to get her to break the seal of nonviolence. Samantha turns off the limitations (no spells, no inventory access) on the crawlers, and turns them back on for the hunters. Carl realizes that Vrah and her mother are filling the castle with mantises and tells Samantha that Diwata will likely be heading her way. Carl's plan is falling apart and the groups outside the castle are struggling, and he decides that he needs to break the seal himself to give his friends a chance to survive. Signet tells Carl that she now understands what he was trying to tell her - that they are part of a show with outside forces calling the shots. She also says that what Tina wants isn't to dance, she wants her mother back. The Sledge and the changelings miraculously make it into the castle. 74 Donut begins her talent performance. She uses a charm potion to make Ferdinand her minion, and Tina dances on stage. Signet uses herself as the blood sacrifice to bring her tattoos to life, breaking the seal and being pulled into the Nothing. The seal is broken and the protections around the castle cease. 75 All out battle ensues. Mongo and Kiwi kill Vrah. Signet's tattoos have been given life permanently, and an incomplete flesh golem of her mother was also created. Carl takes it into his inventory to use later to give Samantha a body. Donut uses the "I take it all back" potion on Kiwi to turn her back into an Ursine, and Tina realizes it is her mother, completing the Recital quest. The Sledge finishes casting Zerzura and the castle and NPCs are teleported away. 76 The AI announces a boss battle between crawlers, hunters, Queen Imogen, and Diwata. Chaos ensues. Donut uses Carl's potion to get her Laundry Day spell to level 15, allowing her to remove the god-armor from Circe Took, who is killed by her own mantis children. The final hunter is eliminated, as are the high elves. Gwendolyn Duet and Cleiton are both killed, and Tran loses his legs. Imogen's spell causes an explosion and Carl passes out as Prepotente attacks Imogen. Imogen is defeated and the Vengeance of the Daughter quest is completed. 77 Donut wakes Carl and tells him that Firas and the Popovs are dead, and that Britney's face is badly burned. Someone named Osvaldo took the memorial crystal off of Imogen, and Prepotente tries to get it from him. Katia kills Eva. Carl finds the Popovs reborn as babies and they are transported to safety since children aren't allowed in the crawl. Carl and Donut are notified that their team, The Princess Posse, is officially part of Faction Wars, and it is revealed that they worked with Donut's fans and Princess D'Nadia to secure two spots. Carl speaks to the audience, telling them that the teams can vote to turn off the safety protocols on the 9th floor and encouraging those who can vote on their government's actions to do so. The feed is cut off. Epilogue Carl, Donut and Prepotente arrive on the 7th floor. Donut chooses the Viper Queen class. Prepotente uses the mysterious items from their sponsors to break the 7th floor level, and everyone proceeds to the 8th floor. It is revealed that in her last moments, Eva placed the Crown of the Sepsis Whore on Katia's head and that only one of her and Donut will be able to proceed past the 9th floor.

title: Leviathan Wakes
author: James S.A. Corey
summary:
Leviathan Wakes James S. A. Corey The Expanse #1 https://expanse.fandom.com/wiki/Leviathan_Wakes#Plot Juliette Andromeda Mao has been abducted from her ship, the Scopuli, and left in a storage locker for 8 days. She breaks out only to find the crew gone and the ship's reactor shut down and covered by a flesh-like biologically active substance. The head of one of her crewmates pokes out from the accumulated biomass and asks her for help.

The Pure 'n' Kleen ice hauler Canterbury intercepts a distress signal from the Scopuli. An away team consisting of the ship's XO (Executive Officer) James Holden, engineers Naomi Nagata and Amos Burton, medical technician Shed Garvey, and pilot Alex Kamal intercept it on the shuttle Knight. They find the Scopuli powerless, with the distress signal emanating from a beacon with a Mars Congressional Republic Navy (MCRN) battery in it. The away team suspect pirates and head back to the Canterbury; however, the vessel is attacked and destroyed by a number of unidentified stealth ships before they make it back.

Holden, now captain of the Knight, broadcasts a message detailing the Cant's destruction, implicating the MCRN in the attack. Pure 'n' Kleen instructs them to meet up with the MCRN flagship, the Donnager, to assist with the investigation. While en route, Holden receives a message from Fred Johnson – the de facto leader of the Outer Planets Alliance (OPA), nicknamed the "butcher of Anderson Station" – on Tycho Station, declaring his support for the former, should the situation worsen. Six stealth ships begin following them.

On Ceres, the largest asteroid in the Asteroid Belt between Mars and Jupiter, Star Helix Detective Josephus Miller, a Belter born on Ceres, but working for the Earth security force there, is given a case to track down Julie Mao and send her back home to her parents on Luna. Riots break out after Holden's transmission about the Cant's destruction at the presumed hands of the MCRN, and it turns out all the station's riot gear is missing. With things getting hairy, Miller's partner Havelock, an Earther, resigns and gets a new job working for Protogen Security.

On the Donnager, Holden is debriefed and Captain Yao insists that the MCRN had nothing to do with the Cant's destruction. The stealth ships attack; the Donnager is ultimately no match and the ship is boarded. Shed is killed when a gauss round (railgun) decapitates him. Since Holden and his crew are the only ones that can exculpate the MCRN, Yao orders Lt. Kelly to get them off the ship; they escape on the light frigate Tachi just before Yao self-destructs the Donnager.

Lt. Kelly, wounded during the escape, dies. Unsure of where to go next, Holden decides to take Fred Johnson up on his offer, so they head to Tycho Station. Fred gives them a new transponder code and Holden renames their ship the Rocinante.

While going through Julie's files, Detective Miller finds a message from Julie's parents warning her of an impending attack, sent two weeks before the Canterbury was destroyed. Anderson Dawes, leader of the Ceres branch of the OPA, tells Miller that Julie was on the Scopuli, and that Miller should lay off the Mao case, with the reasoning that Julie was an OPA member and that they should handle it. He presents his findings to Captain Shaddid and she tells him to drop the case, too.

Miller has become obsessed with Julie, however, and keeps digging. Captain Shaddid, in collusion with the OPA, fires Miller; she gave him the case only because she didn't think he would actually solve it. Miller's replacement partner, Octavia Muss, tells him he's the station's joke, sending him into a deep depression. Even so, he still won't let the Mao case go.

On Tycho, Fred wants the Roci crew's depositions, so he can act as a mediator between Earth and Mars. After a few days of R&R, Holden concludes that he's bored and wants to take work. He receives a job from Fred tracking down Lionel Polanski, an assumed name for an OPA operative, on Eros Station. Holden claims the Roci as salvage, but since the MCRN probably wouldn't buy that, Fred helps him disguise the ship as a gas hauler.

Before he was fired, Detective Miller requested the docking logs for ships that could have come from the Donnager, as Dawes had dropped that Holden was still alive, and since Holden was the one that first investigated Julie's ship, Miller wants to know how this all ties together. Miller narrows the entries down to the Rocinante and heads off to Eros, where it's about due to dock.

On Eros, Holden and his crew go to the hotel where Polanski checked in and are promptly ambushed by gun-wielding assailants. Miller shows up and save the day, then joins their party. In Polanski's room, they find Julie Mao, dead, covered in some sort of infectious-looking brown rapidly spreading bacteria and black tendrils. Miller finds a log on her phone detailing the stages of her sickness, and notes that radiation seems to accelerate growth. They find coordinates for an asteroid where the ship that destroyed the Scopuli is docked.

A radiation attack is declared and station security begins herding people into radiation shelters. Miller recognizes some of the security as criminals from Ceres wearing the missing riot gear and knows something is up. Holden tells his crew to head back to the Rocinante while he and Miller investigate. They find that everyone in the radiation shelters has been gassed and dosed with a lethal amount of radiation, after which they get irradiated as well. On the way back to the Roci, riots break out between the crowds and the security, and Miller and Holden start bleeding from every orifice due to radiation sickness. The irradiated people have been infected with the same virus as Julie and start spilling out from the subway tubes.

Holden and Miller make it back to the Roci just in time; luckily, the advanced medical facilities flush the cancer from their bodies, though they are requested to take anti-cancer meds for the rest of their lives. While Naomi takes care of him, Holden confesses his love to her; she shoots him down because back on the Cant he fell in love with half the young women, and now he solely wants her because she's the only young woman around.

Fred contacts Holden and sends along data from a chip that Lt. Kelly had on him, detailing that the EM signatures of the ships that destroyed the Donnager were made on Earth at the Bush Shipyards. Holden broadcasts this information publicly, causing Earth to preemptively attack Mars. Mars recalls its entire fleet from the Belt and forms a blockade against Earth.

The crew of the Roci, with Miller in tow, head to the asteroid Julie mentioned in her logs. There, they find the stealth ship that destroyed the Scopuli – the Anubis – deserted. The reactor is shut down and is covered in the flesh and body parts from the crews of both the stealth ship and the Scopuli. They find a video from the Protogen Corporation about the Phoebe bug, scientifically dubbed the "protomolecule"; Protogen had discovered that the Saturnian moon wasn't naturally formed, but was actually an alien weapon designed to attack Earth 2.3 billion years ago, when life was just forming, to reprogram humanity into something else. The whole war was simply a distraction, in order for Protogen to run their human experiments. The crew hoofs it before they get infected, but not before taking a souvenir safe; they nuke the stealth ship in their wake.

Holden and co. return to Tycho and tell Fred what they found. Realizing that Eros is beaming data to a hidden Protogen base, Miller contacts his old partner Havelock at Protogen security; Havelock says there's a secret base out there called Thoth and sends Miller the coordinates. Holden tells Miller that he is officially a member of the Roci crew. Miller is extremely happy to finally belong somewhere again that he subsequently weeps.

The Roci kicks off the attack on Thoth by taking out the two stealth ships docked there; then, Fred, Miller, and a group of OPA volunteers storm the station. They're met with only mild resistance; the security only has riot gear with plastic bullets. In the command center, they meet the head of Protogen bio research, Antony Dresden, who is very nonchalant about the whole thing. He explains that all the researchers there were turned into non-empathic psychopaths, and that Eros was simply a test to see what the protomolecule would do when introduced into human test subjects. Dresden explains how important this research is, since there is a clear alien threat trying to wipe out humanity. Before he can convince Holden and the others, Miller shoots him in the head. Holden is furious and kicks Miller out of his crew.

No one will hire Miller anywhere, so he begs Fred for a job; they come up with a plan to destroy Eros by flying the Nauvoo, a generational ship Fred was building for the Mormons, into it and crashing it into Sol.

Fred sends five ships full of fusion bombs to blow up Eros' docking ports, while the Rocinante acts as muscle to stop a UNN science vessel, accompanied by a corvette-class military ship, from docking. After the bomb ships are docked, Miller decides to remain on the station, so he can die when the bombs go off.

Fred launches the Nauvoo, but Eros manages to dodge the vessel. Eros blocks RADAR and LADAR, and begins accelerating towards Earth, faster than any ship can keep up with.

Holden contacts Miller to get the detonation codes for the fusion bombs, only to find he's still on the asteroid, which actually works out for the best: Miller hauls one of the bombs into the station on a cart, hoping to destroy the propelling capacities of protomolecule. Earth launches all of its nukes, targeting the transponders of the docked ships, because it cannot get a target lock any other way.

Miller, after listening closely to the voices coming from the communication system, realizes that it is actually Julie flying the station, while she is under the impression that she is driving her racing pinnace, the Razorback. Miller tells Holden to buy him some time, so Fred diverts the nukes off course, so they'll take longer to get there. Miller finds Julie, wakes her up, and convinces her to wrestle control away from the protomolecule. Julie successfully manages to divert the asteroid's trajectory away from Earth and crash it into Venus.

In the epilogue, Holden affirms that there are two kilometer-high crystal towers growing on the surface of Venus, implying that the protomolecule has survived.

title: The Wandering Inn 18
author: Pirate Aba
summary:
Earthers in Wistram give a presentations and demonstrations, about the shape of both Earth and Innworld, and of combat tactics with an Airsoft gun. The Earthers in Wistram have a therapy session. The archmages spy on the Antinium Hives. Aaron Vanwell (Blackmage) speaks to Amerys in prison. Aaron works with High Mage Telim and the Ullsinoi faction to invent a virtual reality combat game. Wistram issues a broadcast revealing the Golden Triangle as a scam world-wide.

Erin interrupts Venim's day off with his daughter, afterwards talking with Numbtongue over a Peanuts comic, she realizes she might be more Peppermint Patty, than Marcie like she wanted to be. Zevara demotes and transfers Relc to Cellidel, the city is in need of Senior Guards and it would be a temporary assignment. Maviola makes breakfast for Olesm, before heading off to meet with Erin for the day. Maviola and Erin start awkwardly again... before having to burn an explanation for Erin to see with Flames, then after a merger of skills they share each-others memory. Next is teaching both Erin and Lyonette budgeting, before a field trip to Invrisil, where Bethal gets poo thrown at her and riots break out in the streets.

Bethal and the Players of Celum shelter in the Wandering Inn, away from the riot in Invrisil. Pelt leaves Pallass and moves to Esthelm, forging a Dragonblood Crystal sword for Numbtongue as thanks to Erin. Noass and Sir Relz start broadcasting Invrisil's riot, which sparks violent riots in other cities, including Pallass and Liscor. The Lords and an angry mob confront Magnolia, who refuses both to help the people of Invrisil and also end her [Trade War]. Magnolia turns the mob against the lords, as they can't get to her.

Erin tries and fails to stop the riot in Liscor. She instead goes around rescuing her friends and citizens who are sheltering with her magic door and [Invisibility]. The Antinium help the Watch restore order in Liscor. Erin leads a group of her friends into Invrisil to rescue the Lords right as they're about to be lynched. The rescued lords start negotiations for a trade deal with Erin.

Ryoka meets the Silver Swords and runs away when they say they've been looking for her, eventually getting captured. Mrsha experiments with the [Compartments of Holding], and shows Ekirra and Visma the post-riot grief of the Antinium. Shassa Weaverweb (an Oteslian [Druid]) accidentally kidnaps Mrsha, then returns with Nathaliarstrelous to have a meeting of [Druids]. Nathaliarstrelous confronts Bird about his overhunting of birds, but doesn't object much since Bird eats them. Erin plays a game of chess against Teriarch, and he throws a tantrum when he loses. Nathaliarstrelous challenges the Shield Spiders of the floodplains and wipes many of them out.

The selphids assist Geneva in Baleros as the Yellow Rivers plague worsens, and send a message (via Ulinde) to Joseph. Erin impersonates him and speaks with Geneva, eventually revealing that she has antibiotics. Erin gets Octavia to ramp up manufacturing and share the method of reproduciton, and hires Tritel and Ci to deliver what they have to Baleros. Drassi confronts Noass and Sir Relz on-air about their poor journalism, regarding both the Golden Triangle riots and their downplaying of the Yellow Rivers disease. In Zeres, Niers Astoragon's students prepare to travel in search of a cure for Yerranola, who is gravely injured and in agony.

Alrric helps manage Ilvriss' mining company, recruits for Operation Periss (including miners and the Named Adventurer Shriekblade), and has dinner with Ilvriss. He and his daughter are secretly Doombringers, and he is part of a small cabal in Salaszar that hired Bearclaw to try to rescue/kidnap Mrsha. With her failure and disappearance, they've sent one of their own to collect Mrsha, Wanderer.

Richard, Tom and others live in Rhir under Lord Hayvon, and head to 5th wall for training. Cirille, Merish, and the others, stationed together at 5th Wall, have to deal with diversity. King Othius IV speaks to Nereshal and a group of recaptured Mages, and announces his intention to summon more Earthers, sacrificing a hundred thousand unborn children for the spell, despite the moral objections of the Mages. He uses his aura/skills to compel their loyalty.

Lord Hayvon Operland, a high-ranking [Lord] in the service to the Blighted Kingdom of Rhir, subtly manipulates, bribes, and gaslights the Earther [Heroes] into their continued support for the kingdom's war against the Demons of Rhir, despite their desire to go out into the world and find other Earthers. One of the Rhir Earthers smelts titanium weapons. Tom the [Clown] tries to convince Richard that the Blighted Kingdom isn't fighting a noble crusade but is instead a militant ruthless empire that would discard them in an instant if they weren't "useful", but Richard is doubtful. Tom continues to obey and kill Demons anyway because he "has to kill someone".

An Izrilian detatchment, lead by Commander Cirille (a Drake) and Chief Warrior Merish (a plains Gnoll) is deployed to the 5th Wall - a massive barrier under construction along the Blighted Kingdom's front lines against the Demons. Once there, they find the front is staffed by soldiers and warriors from all around the world, from Ailendamus' [Knights], to Terandrian [Hunters], Lizardfolk warriors from Baleros, [Flesh Reapers] from A'ctelios Salash who eat their fallen enemies, [Martial Artists], and even [Necromancers]. So are the Earthers, including Tom the [Clown] and his groupies/imitators, the Gloomless Troupe.

The Demons begin an attack on the 5th Wall, sending thousands of soldiers and a new form of giant self-duplicating serpent.

The Serpent-Titans attack 5th wall. Cirille, Merish, and the others develop new tactics based on synergy between their groups. Flora tells Giants about guns. Cirille and Merish's detatchments defend the 5th Wall against the demon attacks, along with Tom the [Clown] and the other soldiers of Rhir. Bastion-General Quiteil uses his Skills and expends a Tier 7 scroll [Arrow of Winter: Glacius Pillar] to make a mile-radius blast zone of cold. After the battle, racial and cultural tensions between the various factions defending the wall heighten. Tom does crappy, un-funny stand-up comedy that makes almost everyone uncomfortable.

Cirille and Merish spend time training together, trying to make their forces work better together and ease the tension. Huntress Delezza, a high-level [Demon Hunter], dies of injuries from the battle while the Earthers are trying to get her a blood transfusion. Cirille recieves and accepts an invitation to join Ilvriss' Operation Periss.

We discover that both Harpies and Giants aren't extinct, but that they've joined the Demons of Rhir.

Silvenia attacks 5th wall. Cirille discovers that her message to Ilvriss accepting his employment offer was intercepted and altered. As she goes to investigate how and why, the undead in their camp start going rogue as the Demons attack, beginning with an area confusion spell and compromising their [Message] spells and artifacts.

Silvenia (leading an army of illusory Demons) kills the Bastion-General of the Fifth Wall, and almost the entire detatchment of soliders defending it. Tom the [Clown] tries to kill her, but she effortlessly kills him by ripping him into tiny pieces. She and her forces destroy the 5th Wall and begin seeding the area with Creler eggs to make it uninhabitable.

Bastion-General Quiteil expends a million gold pieces worth of consumables to push her back and prevent her from destroying the 4th Wall as well. Lord Hayvon attempts to retake the position of the 5th Wall, now in ruin. Silvenia, the Death of Magic, one of the Deathless, is ordered to retreat by the Demon King.

Cirille is found dead after the battle. Tom is alive as well; Silvenia only killed his Skill-duplicate. The Izrilian detachment returns to Izril, after losing most of their soldiers. Lord Hayvon uses his skill, [Pride of the Fallen], to send ghostly copies of the fallen soldiers home, to spread word of the Deathless of the Demons' return, and request reinforcement.

Erin and Mrsha recieve a letter from Ryoka, and then write their own back in reply. Mrsha's writing is shockingly good, tutored by Lyonette to write like a princess. Mrsha realizes (with Teriarch's help) that she can write out phrases onto cards to communicate, and goes around insulting everyone in the inn until Maviola teaches her a lesson.

Liscor's council recieves a letter informing them that Hectval's city leadership accepted their invitation, and is coming to meet with them. Shriekblade and [Assassins] around Izril recieve a letter outlining a contract.

King Raelt of Jecrass recieves letters from various leaders of the surrounding kingdoms, offering him piecemeal aid; insufficient to win the war against the King of Destruction. He leads a near charge into the King of Destruction's forces, and manages to pin down Flos and stab him through the heart by sheer luck and sacrifice. It is meaningless, as Flos just heals up with a potion. Raelt and all of Jecrass' forces retreat from Belchan entirely and form up at their borders. Raelt announces his intention to sue for peace to the other rulers, knowing he can't win the war.

The Horns of Hammerad interrupt a careful collection of adventurers who were trying to take out a group of Face-Eater Moths by charioting in and causing havoc, obliterating the moths. They save the village, which is in the lands of House Byres, and the villagers recognize Yvlon. The Horns make their way to Yvlon's home, and meet with her parents. Ksmvr asks for one of the trees on House Byres' land.

Ryoka sends a letter to Laken, presumably about the Solstice party, and she and Fierre begin travelling in the Unmarked Carriage towards First Landing. Fierre takes the panacea and starts vomiting repeatedly.

Selys goes around asking people what she should invest her money in. A new employee of the Wandering Inn, Welle, gets mugged in Liscor, and though Hawk witnessed the crime, he did nothing about it. Erin discovers Relc was transferred to Cellidel and already left a week ago. Hawk and Selys break up.

Selys goes to Pallass to find investment opportunities, and runs into Onieva. Onieva is looking for a new place to set up a Turnscale bar, and considering the Wandering Inn, but decides to try testing Selys and then Erin to see if they're homophobic. Rose suggests a variant of Romeo and Juliet where both leads are gay men, and nearly gets lynched before Erin rushes to defend her. Rose realizes that this world is extremely homophobic, and Onieva overhears the entire affair.

Selys and Erin talk more about possible ideas on what Selys could do with her money, and discover that Kevin knows how bicycles work. Kevin works with Palt, Hedault, and Pelt (funded by Selys) to design a bicycle, and as an aside, builds a skateboard. In Pallass, Kevin, Hedault, and a bunch of the city's teenagers skateboard down the giant level-to-level ramps. Leon and Troy secretly sell information to Grimalkin.

Klbkch, Anand, and some Painted Antinium arrive in the Hivelands to show off the Free Hive's accomplishments. Klbkch fights the Grand Queen's prognugators, who are copies of him, and defeats them all at once with his [Recaptured Sublimity] Skill. The Queens show Klbkch their preparations for the future: The Grand Queen has constructed and stockpiled food, so they can create and sustain an army 23 times larger than their best from the First Antinium War. The Silent Queen created elite Antinium, including some which use bright light-based attacks to disorient and blind enemies. The Armored Queen created giant Soldiers, who are big and will draw enemy fire and waste their Skills. The Flying Queen is working on flight and projectile weapons. The Twisted Queen created new Birthers which can continue without the need for maintenance by Queens.

Anand creates a grave marker for General Sserys at the place where he was killed in the Hivelands during the First Antinium War.

Salamani the Mage Runner tries to deliver Lady Ieka's message to the Archmage of Izril. Ryoka and Fierre ride the Unmarked Carriage, discovering that it's run by a Djinni named Karsaeu-Dequoa. Several criminals ride with them, including a [Trapmaster Assassin], two [Gang Leaders], a Brother of Seredipitous Meetings, and a Sister of Chell. Ryoka and Fierre arrive on the island of the Archmage of Izril.

Rabbiteater sets sail on a ship bound for Terandria with the Knights of the Order of Seasons, still in disguise as "Ser Solstice".

Octavia's antibiotic (now named Occilium) proves to be effective at fighting Yellow Rivers in Zeres. Lyonette removes her boon from Octavia and gives it to Numbtongue instead. Ferris continues to fail in his attempt to get Erin to visit the Walled City of Manus. Gresaria Wellfar, [Harbormistress] of First Landing, shows up in a chariot and attacks Maviola, as a way to say goodbye to her. Az'kerash trains his Chosen by having them practice attacking Belavierr. Upset at their failures and Toren's success, they bully Toren and beat him until he nearly dies. Toren hides, and meets the Healing Slime, bonding over their mutual fear of their captors.

Orjin of Pomle ponders how to fight enemies like the Death of Magic or a Kraken. Salii expands Pomle, refilling the oasis, creating a televised fighting arena, and an area of exceptional harshness for improved training. Grimalkin tries to put more pieces together about "Earth", and realizes that Lady Pryde is sending him weight-lifting numbers as a competition.

Griffon Hunt arrives in Windrest, and Halrac is upset to find nothing left but ash. They head to Riverfarm, and discover that almost all the Windrest villagers survived and moved here. [Emperor] Laken tries to hire them, and they're initially skeptical. They take out a nest of Juvenile Crelers, and then start excavating several spots around the Unseen Empire, discovering treasure, and deciding to stay and accept Laken's offer. They investigate the Goblinlands and find Pebblesnatch.

Erin gets the black flour from Oteslia, and tries to make her "Midnight Bread", but fails and makes a Shadowloaf instead. Saliss comes by the inn, and Erin orders coffee beans and more cocoa beans from Oteslia. Saliss introduces himself to Rose. Niers Astoragon's students head to Oteslia carrying the poisoned Yerranola, chased by pirates and seafolk. Part of Feshi's Weatherfur tribe comes to defend them. We discover that Oteslia's First Gardener has an adoptive son who is a Dragon in disguise: "Cire"

Ryoka and Fierre begin trying to get into the Archmage of Izril's mansion. They discover the minefield, artillery spells, the fake illusory mansion, get trapped inside the real mansion, get past a mirror-clone room, golems, poison gas, and a maze. They're finally captured after Fierre succumbs to an insanity trap. Taken prisoner, Ryoka uses her friendship with the wind to help her, Fierre, and Salamani escape and collect a bunch of magic from previous invaders. They decide continuing is too dangerous, and blast their way back out of the mansion.

Still pissed off, and only needing to get the Archmage's attention, they use their new arsenal of magic items and set fire to her island and launch a massive attack on her mansion. It works, wakes up the Archmage, and Ryoka completes the delivery with a dash of Ryoka sass.

The Guild of Assassins ambushes Magnolia Reinhart while she's on the road, at the behest of the Circle of Thorns. They manage to kill Sacra, two more maids, and cut of Reynold's legs, leaving Magnolia with only Ressa for defense. They're about to kill Magnolia when Tyrion rides to her defense. Teriarch teleports Magnolia, Ressa, and Reynold to safety, leaving Tyrion behind by himself to defend against the now furious assassins. They are called off by the Circle, and the Circle of Thorns decides that they're going to force Tyrion to help them as a servant, rather than the ally they wanted.

title: The Fever Code
author: James Dashner
summary:
The Fever Code James Dashner The Maze Runner #0.6

The book starts with Newt and his younger sister Lizzy, who were living in a basement with their parents. It snowed that morning, which was unexpected but welcome, and Newt, Lizzy, and their mother watched from the window. Suddenly, WICKED agents forced their way in and demanded the girl, Lizzy, as they knew she was Immune. The parents refused to hand her over. Newt's dad shot one of the men in the leg in an attempt to protect his daughter, but a woman pulled out her own weapon and shot Newt's father and mother dead. Someone said that they should also take Newt as a control subject, and both he and Lizzy were taken away. It is never revealed what Newt's original name was.

The point of view switches to Stephen, who was nearly five years old and had just been taken by WICKED. WICKED had tried to force the name Thomas upon him, but had proven resistant. A man named Randall Spilker injected him with a pain stimulator, and after terrible bouts of pain, asked Stephen what his name was. Finally, Stephen admitted that his name was Thomas. He was emotionally scarred after this experience.

Thomas attended advanced classes with various tutors for several years. During this time, he became acquainted with Dr. Ava Paige, whom he liked most out of all the WICKED staff. After three years, Thomas was finally allowed to meet Teresa, a girl about his age who had a room next door. Very soon, after a few conversations with her, the two were promoted to building the Maze. But right after that, Thomas and Teresa met a few of the “others”, who were kept away from them in a different part of the WICKED facility. Newt, Minho, and Alby quickly became good friends with Thomas and Teresa, and they sneaked around the facility together, having fun every night for nearly a week. But the friends brought some trouble. The three (Newt, Minho, and Alby) took Thomas and Teresa into the outside world, only to be caught by WICKED. With the exception of Newt, who was not immune, the four of them were forced to venture into the Crank pits. John Michael, the Flare-ravaged founder of WICKED, appeared with a small chalkboard and wrote "WICKED is good" on it. He begged the kids to find a Cure, and then, at his request, Randall Spilker shot him.

The experience really got through to the kids. They did not have any more secret meetings in the maintenance room for quite a while, but then Teresa managed to hack WICKED’s security systems and allowed the friends to meet. On one of their meetings, Thomas and Teresa stumbled upon a younger kid named Charles, whom Thomas immediately nicknamed Chuck. He became the little brother they never had. Pretty soon, the secret meetings were back in business. But Minho was planning something big - escaping WICKED. Hating the fact that he was treated like a lab rat, Minho allied with Gally to form a plan, though none of the others agreed to leave with them.

The day after WICKED found out that Minho tried to escape, they unleashed a Griever on Minho and forced Thomas to watch from a screen, demonstrating to both of them that anyone who tried to escape would be harshly punished. They were also still working on the Griever itself and used this as a chance to test its mechanics, as well as study the reactions of both Thomas and Minho. While they did stop the Griever right before it actually hurt Minho, they repeated the experience several times, having Teresa, Aris, and Rachel watch each subsequent time, leaving Minho traumatized. After the horrifying experience, Thomas went back and directed all his attention to building the Maze. Some time later, the Maze was complete.

Right before they were sent in, Thomas went to say his goodbyes. His friends, who had been tolerating the idea of being sent in up until then, suddenly realized that Thomas and Teresa were not going in with them, and they felt betrayed. When Thomas was not able to answer truthfully about the Maze being his project, it only made his friends hate him more.

After the initial group of forty or so were sent to the Maze, Thomas went to the observation room to check in on his friends; to his horror, he realized that they had all had their memories wiped, which had never been mentioned to him. Day after day, he watched them from the observation room. Sometimes Chuck or Teresa joined him.

About a year after the beginning of the Maze Trials, Dr. Paige told him and Teresa that she suspected there was an outbreak of the Flare among some of the staff. They went to Chancellor Kevin Anderson's quarters, where they found that the chancellor was past the Gone, though not violent. Paige looked through some files on the chancellor's computer, and she deduced that he was covering up the Flare outbreak. She then went and got Rachel and Aris, along with four backpacks full of weapons and syringes of poison that would kill quickly. Paige told them that, being the few Immune available for the job, it was up to them to kill the chancellor and all nineteen other Flare-infected. Thomas and Rachel were horrified, but Teresa and Aris seemed resigned to doing it for the common good. All four of them euthanized the Cranks; Thomas and Teresa each nearly died when a fight broke out with some Cranks and were forced to shoot two of them dead.

After the Purge, Thomas did not go to the observation room for some time. When he finally did, the first thing he saw on the screen was Newt limping along with Alby helping him. He looked at footage from the day before and pieced it all together, realizing that Newt had climbed up a wall in the Maze and tried to kill himself by jumping off, succeeding only in injuring his right leg.

Nearly a year later, he met Jorge and Brenda, two Immunes who were going to be sent to the Scorch along with a team to conduct research. As the new chancellor, Paige sent Thomas along with them to test the long-range efficacy of his brain implant. On the Berg flight there, Brenda and Thomas had a conversation, with Brenda saying that she could tell that Thomas and Teresa were clearly more than friends and that Thomas should make a move.

In the Scorch, Brenda and Jorge headed together toward the Crank city, while Thomas headed with the team to an underground tunnel, which someone explained was originally made by inmates escaping from a prison, and that WICKED had claimed it for their own purposes. They headed deep into the tunnel and activated a Flat Trans, stepping through to find themselves back in a brick building that was part of the WICKED facilities. Dr. Paige and Teresa were there to greet Thomas, and Teresa hugged him. Instead of riding the few miles back to the main facility with them, Thomas elected to walk there himself, even though it was at night; Paige assigned two guards to escort him. On the way there, they were ambushed by a Flare-crazed Randall Spilker, whom Thomas had not seen for some time. He killed both guards and sneaked through the trees, stalking Thomas. Thomas picked up a fallen guard's Launcher and contacted Teresa telepathically. Spilker charged him, and Thomas incapacitated him with a Launcher grenade. Then, he smashed his head in with the butt end of the Launcher. When Teresa and some others came to help him, they found him sitting there, horrified at what he had done.

Day after day of seeing the horrors of the Maze made Thomas determined to do something about it. He concocted a plan and got Teresa's approval. They planned to get Paige to allow them to go into the Maze with their memories intact; once there, however, they secretly intended to lead the Gladers to freedom outside of WICKED. Paige seemed to agree to their plan.

The night before Thomas went up into the Maze, Teresa and Thomas had a heartfelt conversation, in which Teresa pinkie-promised that they would soon be together in the Maze, both memories intact. She also told Thomas that he meant the world to her. They hugged and lay together in Thomas's bed all night long.

However, the next morning Paige drugged Thomas with a cup of tea. As he slipped into unconsciousness, Paige told him that he was too trusting. She also admitted to him that it was she who had unleashed the Flare on the former chancellor and the nineteen others, all because they had disagreed with her vision for the Trials.

Thomas's memory was wiped and he was placed in the Maze. At the very end of the book, there was an email from Teresa to the WICKED staff, saying that she thought the plan for her to keep her memories and coordinate things telepathically with Aris was a good one. She stated that she appreciated everything WICKED had done for her over the years and that, before going up in the Box, she would write "WICKED is good" on her arm, hoping that it would plant a seed in the minds of the Gladers who saw it.

title: The Strength of the Few
author: James Islington
summary:
The Strength of the Few James Islington The Hierarchy #2

This book jumps between following the three different Vis Telimus’ / Diago’s. One (from the last book) on Res, the world we know from the first book that has Caten and Roman themes. This Vis lost his arm after the udequiem. The second on is on Obiteum, where Vis meets with Caeror and is given a scarab amulet vitirium to keep him alive, plus it provides him with will (This world is egyptian themed). The third one is on Luceum, where Vis does not even realize he is on a different world for most of the book (This one is Norse themed and he also lost his arm here).

Vis is synchronous, which seems to give him some unique powers such as the ability to take others will out of objects, as well as sense when his other selves are hurt. But Ka and many others do not want anyone to be synchronous, so they keep try8ing to kill him.

On Res, Vis learns from veridius that he is trying to prevent another cataclysm since they happen every 300 ish years. He says he wants to work for the censor (Callidus’ father) in Governance, causing a stir. He needs to be tested and touch an aurora columni to use will.

In Obiteum, Caeror also tells Vis about him and Veridius trying to stop a cataclysm, and warns him that someone named Ka is also synchronous and wants to kill him. He has bird humans called gleaners that patrol outside of his city (with a big pyramid). He takes vis to a group of rebelish people living outside the city.

In Luceum, Vis is taken on a boat by strange people who have bad intentions, a druid (called Dree) talks to him in Ancient Vitusian and says he will help him escape. They are on a boat.

In Res, when Vis goes with Ulsicor (apparently that is how you spell it) and Lanistea (the girls name) to the Aurora, she freaks out and tries to kill Vis, saying the phrase “Complete the journey warrior” over and over. She clearly has some compulsion to stop him being synchronous. The Aurora Columni are also getting brighter, probably has to do with the impending cataclysm. Lanistea gets imprisoned for killing guards and Vis is taken away. Next he has to be tested for aptitude, but first is visited by the man with a scar from the first book who seems to be working with the ANguis. He teaches Vis about the ability of Adoption, how he can take and use others will in objects. Vis uses this and his natural talent to do very well in his trials despite only having one arm. After his trials are done Tercius Decamus (Iro’s father and a member of religion) says that Vis should relinquish the title of Domitor to Indoll, since he is no longer the best. Vis says no so he gets talked into doing a chariot race with Aequa against Indoll and Iro, winner take all. This threatens the peace between religion and governance, Military is basically already hostile to them. Vis and Aequa barely win, and Iro is sent into a coma in the loss. Aequa’s father talks everyone into making her a quintus and Vis a Sextus.

Obiteum: Vis and Caeror experiment with his abilities while hiding out from Ka in this underground town. Their are dead bodies called Unqutee who can be controlled with obsidian blades. Since Vis is Synchronous he can override Ka’s control of these bodies (like half the population is actually dead people infused with will in this world). Not much happens here for a while, Caeror is super nice and friendly and they train

Luceum: Vis and the Dree run away, get to a village, but the people hunting them are right behind. The dree is confident he won’t be harmed (they are viewed as like messengers of god) and gives Vis his staff. He then gets beheaded. The father of a family dies saving Vis and he runs away with the mother and 2 children to the mother’s father house on a farm. He lives happily working with his new family and they all have a splendid time, until eventually another druid named keir or something finds Vis and says he needs to take him away. They go meet King Rourdon or something and Vis is told he will go to warrior school but many are mad he picked up a Druid’s staff. He has to fight the kings big ugly champion galgavar for some reason. He is told to pick up a spear and chooses one he feels pulses of will from. While they duel he is overcome by the will in his spear and condemns Galkavar for killing the kings ex-champion. Galkavar hits Vis very hard but then is exiled based on Vis’ claims. Vis gets sent to warrior school to make friends and train.

Res: Vis maintains his ties to his Telimus family, tried to discover who in the Anguis knew about the attack and thus caused Calidus’ death. Oh also Callidus’ sister lizzie is underneath Vis in his pyramid, she does not really like him. Vis goes to visit Viridius at the academy because Emeesa asks him to. Him, Iden, and Aequaa explore the ruins and Vis almost dies. Viridius tells them he wants to stop the cataclysm again. They leave. Vis meets with Acteliois or whoevber, the guy with the scar who can jump between worlds. He takes Vis to a military meetings of all of the highest ranks (princeps etc.) and they learn that they know the cataclysm are coming and won’t stop it. Vis and Diago (his alopie wolf he picked up at sola vargas) kill them all. Vis now has an alter ego wearing this metal mask and pretending to have an arm. He kills people routinely and starts a civil war in Caten. Everything gets murky. Ulcisor is somewhere who knows and him and Cadmus the dispensator run the household in the city.

Obiteum: Vis breaks into Ka’s city by letting gleaner stab him and carry him in. He frees a dead guy about to be made a gleaner and they are friends fora while before the dead guy kills himself. They meet an assassin noble woman Netifret who helps Vis break into the Nomark, the ruling dead body of the city 1 level under Ka.

Luceum: Vis and his friends learn of an attack by Galkavar and a rival king, they kill a scouting party and Vis spots his father. They leave to join the war and Vis gets taken by Keir the druid to go a different way to learn the Nazgan (will). Vis sneaks away and finds his father, a Unqtee dead guy sent here by Actelios and they are happy, but Vis denies his father and continues with the druid. He breaks the test in some city because he is Synchronous then gets captured by Galkavar and KLeir is killed. Vis is led to the siege of King Raounons castle in shame with a silver arm he took from a robot thing.

Res: Vis tries to save everyone. Aequa gets killed by Senator Tercius Decamus (Iro’s father_ because Iro is dead now. He also breaks Vis’ legs, but Vis uses his main character powers to make a cast and go into prison to save Lanistea. He learns ulscior also in prison. Sees Reluqia (Ulscor wife who works for the Anguis) but leaves her in the Sapper. Frees the other 2 and gets them out of the city. Then goes to save Iden. Tells him who he really is (diago and murderer ) to get him to come with him. They try to find Ka.

Obiteum: Vis flees the city, goes and gets a crook and flail from behind a magic synchronous door, and returns and kills and breaks a ton of stuff. Netifret helps him, he breaks into the central pyramid and presumably kills Ka (an old guy sleeping on a stone)

Lyceum:

Vis and King Raounon are killed, but while Vis sinks in a river his father appears and gives him a vitareum (Scarab amulet with will) to save Vis but it kills him since he needed it. The silver arm fuses onto Vis and he can control it. He swims back up, grabs Keir’s staff, goesinto a vision and talks to Kewir, Then challenges Galkavar and kills him so the other kings men flee. Go Vis!!!

Res; Vis and Iden summon Ka, he sends a Unqee to guide them to the necropolis, but then under it to where Military hgave bee nstashing dead bodies for years. Iden says no but Vis is bad guy now, and presumably the only synchronous being capable of causing a cataclysm which is necessary to fight the concurrence. He now has an army of 80,000 dead and the will of a princeps. The dead include his mother, sister and Callidus.

title: Assassin's Quest
author: Robin Hobb
summary:
Assassin’s Quest Robin Hobb The Farseer Trilogy #3

FitzChivalry comes back from the dead. He used his wit bond with Nighteyes to hide his soul away in the wolf’s body and live with him for a few days. Because of his royal blood he was buried unmolested, and Patience was allowed to clean and tend his wounds. Burrich and Chade dig him up and are the only ones who know the truth of him living. For the first months he is still more wolf than man and does not remember much, but Burrich lives in a far off shepherds hut with him while he recovers and remembers himself. Regal has retreated with the court to Tradesford and the coastal duchies are more alone than ever.

As he becomes more human Verity skills to him one night saying that he is alive, sending Chade to start a quest in the name of the true king and save the sic duchies. Burrich eventually leaves Fitz to himself and goes to take care of “a friend”. Fitz almost reverts to animalistic ways but snaps out of it. Gets attacked by forged ones and kills one then has to flee. Much later he comes back to get supplies because he has decided to kill Regal as a personal vendetta (He clearly has PTSD from the dungeon and Regal’s men beating him). He finds the dead body of one of the forged ones he killed still outside the hut, but Burrich had been there and left clothes for him inside. Fitz does not realize but Burrich assumed the corpse was Fitz and thinks he is truly dead now. We later learn he is taking care of Molly who is pregnant with Fitz’ child.

Nighteyes and Fitz head inland to Tradesford to kill Regal, and Fitz tries to remember how to be a person. Along the way they meet a blind minstrel and his daughters, who attach themselves to him temporarily and he kills forged ones to save them. Later he helps a man who turns out to be “Old-Blood” (witted) and is bonded to a bear. He takes them to his hut and gives them some warnings and more info about their bond.
