The battle happens and Celene and Gabe kills a ton of wretched, but when the terrors show up and phoebe pounces on them, the Dyvok from earlier show up and Kiara shatters the bridge, dropping the terrors away and trying to claim Dior for herself. Dior falls but Gabe catches her and Celene catches him, but once Dior is up Celene drops Gabe. Phoebe was also thrown off the bridge.

Jean-Francois stands up and Gabe is confused, but Jean-Francois says this story is about Dior, and since Gabe fell and was not with Dior he would go somewhere else. He descends into the depths of the palace, where they have a small prison with a flowing river around it. Celene is imprisoned on the rock patch wearing a silver mask. Jean-Francois begins to interview her and she insults Gabe, saying he is a drunkard and a liar, making him an even more unreliable narrator. Celene also gives a different view of their family, their mother only loved Gabe and was mean to everyone else, but their father raised her to be a Castia, a mountain, and she loved him a lot.

Celene tells how Kiara almost killed her, and she was forced to flee to her blood moth form, but she left one moth with Dior to travel with her. Kiara captured her since the Voss seem to want her. Dior is taken prisoner and brought back to the main Dyvok camp, after a failed escape attempt. She is packed in a wagon and finds the children from earlier, who say Lachlan left them, Baptiste, who is still alive, and Aaron, who was killed but rose again as a vampire. SInce he is a vampire his silver tattoos are agony to him and he screams every day. During Dior’s escape attempt she used her blood to save a young hound boy, Joaquin Marenn, so now Kiara knows what she can do. They travel to the Dyvok’s new capital, Dun Margaen. They have somehow managed to capture all of Ossway in two years and no one knows how.

Dior is presented to the highblood court, led by Priori Nikiti Blackheart, and his elder sister Lilidh, the Heartless. They are the eldest Dyvok since Gabe killed their father Tolyev. Nikita claims Aaron as his prize and makes him drink his blood. Lilidh claims Dior. Their is much unrest among the violent Dyvok, and they are brutal and keep many humans around to drink from. Kiara also claims to have killed Gabriel. Lilidh keeps a giant white wolf named Prince, and has some maidservants, one called worm. She makes worm stab herself to see how Dior’s blood works. Dior is taken down to a dungeon after being forced to drink Lilidh’s blood.

Celene knows Mother Maryn is somewhere in/beneath the city, so spends her time healing and flying around trying to find her, but with no luck. Dior gets dressed up by Worm, and Lilidh makes her drink more blood. Dior makes another escape attempt with a hairpin, and runs into Joaquin but he does not report her. She then tries to bring Baptiste with her, since it has not been three nights yet he should not be a thrall, but he goes and gets Kiara. She bound him weeks ago when they first captured him.

Aaron has been thralled by Nikita and Nikita makes him butcher the human prisoners and keeps him as his closest lover. Dior is forced to drink from Lilidh a third time, and Celene can still do nothing. Lilidh commands Dior and the other maids to beat Worm and Dior complies, seeming to be fully a thrall. Celene wonders where gabe is and feels she messed up. The Voss and The Terrors show up asking for Dior in exchange for a bunch of humans, and Lilidh and Nikita argue about it. Nikita and Fabien used to be lovers. The Voss wait a ways outside the city for an answer.

Jean-Francois leaves her to go hear from Gabe again. Upon learning Celene is a prisoner Gabe also insults her a bunch and says she is a faithless liar. After he fell from the bridge Phoebe, who is very sturdy and hard to kill, nursed him back to health and together they set off after Dior (who has a vial of gabe’s blood so he can track her). On the way they become closer, and stop in Redwatch for supplies, where Gabe rebuffs Phoebe, and she leaves alone to get Dior. Gabe is then captured by Lachlan and two other silversaints a few nights later, along with the inquisitor lady from the first book. They are taking him to Augustine to hang him. He tries to explain but no one will listen. They enter one of the blighted woods, despite Gabe warning them, and people start disappearing. Eventually they all go to look, leaving only two guards on Gabe, and Phoebe appears and frees him, althoug he tells her not to kill the Silversaint apprentice. They steal horses and fleas, but after a few days a storm forced them to hide in Ravenswatch. They grow even closer and are about to engage in sex, when the three silversaints show up again and attack them. They incapacitate two, with Gabe seeming stronger than he should be, but Lachlan shoots Phoebe with silvershot. Gabe tackles him and finally is able to explain what happened and Lachlan lets him leave. He has to take Phoebe to the Highlands since her aunt is a great healer and she is dying.

He reaches the edge of the Highlands and is attacked by a giant bear he can’t kill, so he bites her and drinks her blood, then is able to overpower the bear, who turns out to be a duskdancer. He is taken prisoner but Phoebe is saved and all the highlanders gather for a discussion. They have made a pact with Lilidh Dyvok to have peace though so they most likely will not help attack Dun Margaen. Gabe and Phoebe have sexy time and she asks him to bite her, he does and gets carried away and almost drains her dry, so Brynna, the bear duskdancer, shows up and attacks him. Gabe is able to fight off a ton of duskdancers and Phoebe stops everyone. They realize that duskdancer blood, which is blighted since daysdeath, give both palebloods and coldbloods(vampires) super strength skills, and that is what is in the vials the Dyvoks have around their necks, this angers them and they agree to attack.

Jean-Francois goes back to Celene, who still watches Dior. Dior seems to be fully Lilidh’s thrall, they lie together in sleep. Lilidh leaves and Worm (the handmaid) enters through a secret door with a knife, but her and Dior discuss. Dior is not a thrall, her blood makes her immune, and anyone she has healed has their bonds broken. They realize they need to fight back from inside somehow. Dior knew because Joaquin is also free from Kiara. Worm’s real name is Princess Reyne, daughter of the slain ruler of this land. She takes some of Dior’s blood and frees the other handmaids of Lilidh, and their men. Joaquin asks Dior to free Isla (One of the girls from the prison wagon in Avalene who was brought here and is now a servant to Nikita, and Dior agrees). They use the secret tunnels to meet in a chapel. They have like 8 people freed but that is not enough and they need a plan. While trying to get silver swords from a statue they open a secret tunnel with the Esani symbol, Celene can’t enter since it is holy ground but Dior and Reyne come back up looking horrorstruck and go into a plan to kill Nikita and Lilidh. Dior tells Celene to go in person to Gabe and ask him to wait a day to attack.

Gabriel is brought into Celene ‘s dungeon and after insulting each other they tell the story in tandem. Gabe and Phoebe have brought an army of duskdancers to the wall and wait to attack. Nikita orders all of the thrallswords and humans to the walls so they will die first, but Dior is trying to make a plan to free them. Nikita suddenly summons everyone to his throneroom, and once their starts to single out members of their freed conspiracy, seemingly by chance, but then makes them stab each other and does not let Dior heal them. He reveals to Lilidh they are free and Isla comes forward. She has always served him, she is the one who let him into Avalene and now has betrayed the conspiracy. Their is much violence from both sides, Dior uses her blood to save Reyne but everyone else is pretty much killed. Dior and Reyne are taken to the dungeons for the battle.

Celene is in a tent with gabe and tells him of her past, how she was killed by Laure Voss, how when they were young, Gabe almost died of sickness so his mom summoned his vampire father, but Celene followed in secret so learned what gabe was young. His father gave some of his blood to save Gabe. When Celene was killed she went to find him since he was the only vampire she knew, Wulfric, her now dead teacher. Celene tells them what is happening in the throneroom and they launch the attack now. But as soon as they reach the first wall, they find many of the thralls free and making others drink. Joaquin introduces himself to Gabe and says how him and Dior planned to put her blood in the liquor. Baptiste is also freed now and wants to help Aaron. They attack and there is a huge battle, many things destroyed and side characters killed, but suddenly Lachlan and a ton of silversaints and silversisters show up and swing the tide, forcing the Dyvok to retreat to the keep.

But when all seemed good the Voss came from behind, so they are fighting on two sides. Gabe and Celene go after the Terrors to break their control. During the fight they say that Celene killed Wulfric, that is how she has so much power. Gabe is furious and Fabien speaks to him from a wretched, saying not to kill his daughters or he will regret it but Celene and Gabe each kill one.

Back in the keep Nikita tells Kiara to go get Dior to give to Fabien for help. Kiara descends into the dungeon but then kills Isla and the gaurds, she hates Nikita now and is going to free Dior and Reyne to spite him and especially Lilidh, but Lilidh and Kane (The Headsmun) catch up and they trade in the battle, Lilidh is hurt but kills Kiara but Kiara kills Kane, and Prince is almost killed but bites Dior. Dior and Reyne are both hurt but flee to the hidden underground chamber since it is holy ground.

Nikita and Aaron are fighting outside, Lachlan is battling Nikita, who is actually his half-brother. Gabe freed him from the Dyvok when he was young, and Baptiste has spent this whole time trying to appeal to Aaron’s love of him. They all fall from a wall and Lachlan is almost dead and Nikita has Baptiste, and because he is cruel he tells Aaron to kill baptiste. Aaron takes Nikita’s sword but resists his bond enough to throw the sword away and Baptiste gets a hit on Nikita with a silver hammer, then Lachlan grabs Nikita’s legs so he can’t flee and Baptiste kills him, freeing Aaron from his bond.

Gabe and Celene have been sprinting for Dior. Lilidh is outside the holy ground, but reads, written on the wall some scripture saying “Enter here …”, which counts as an invitation so she steps in. Dior and Reyne flee into the deeper secret tunnel from earlier. It is dark and dank and this is clearly the resting place of Mother Maryn. In the dim light Reyne gets a cut on Lilidh with a blade soaked in Dior’s blood, but since there is water on the ground it is quickly extinguished. Lilidh gets burned more, but manages to almost kill Reyne, then pins Dior’s hand to a statue with a dagger. Dior spits blood in her face then rips her hand free, severing all but her thumb and index finger, then Prince shows up and attacks Lilidh, distracting her so Dior can stab her with a bloody blade and she begins to burn. Dior tries to heal Reyne but she seems to be dead, but then she breathes, barely alive. Gabe and Celene show up, and Dior calls Gabe father and he calls her daughter and Phoebe runs in and Prince turns out to be her husband Connor, who she thought dead. Sad for her and gabe but happy overall.

They look at the statues in the room, of five priests and the redeemer, mortal son of God. They recognize one of the priests as Fabien and realize when the redeemer told his betrayers to have eternal life, it was a curse. He made the first five vampires of the five bloodlines. Gabe is distraught and since Celene knew, all of her lies compounded and he attacked her. As they fought and Phoebe tried to break them up, Lilidh rose from the water. She was not dead since she had not heart (The heartless), and she grabbed Dior and broke her neck. Connor/Prince lunged on her and killed her, but she killed him in the process, he got brought back just to hurt Phoebe more.

Modern time, Gabe is so filled with rage he lunges across the river and attacks Celene, breaking her silver mask. They brawl and Jean-Francois makes the guards go separate them and send gabe away. Celene tells how they had a state funeral for Dior, named her San Dior, or the Saint of the grail, or other names, but Gabe had already fled before the funeral to somewhere. All the silversaints but Lachlan died in the fighting.

Back in his tower Gabe succumbs to his sangire (blood thirst) and asks for Dario to be left with him. After the Vampire leaves Dario is revealed to be Joaquin, and they have a plan brewing. Back in her prison, Celene recounts to a mouse how she went to meet Mother Maryn, who turned out be a young girl in vampire form, and then in Dior’s tomb, Dior opened her eyes. THE END.

title: The Wandering Inn 20
author: Pirate Aba
summary:
The Wandering Inn #20 Pirateaba The Wandering Inn #20 The Wandering Inn #20 Summary

https://wiki.wanderinginn.com/Book_20/tl;dr

Xrn kidnaps Ryoka to have a conversation. Saliss gets a summons for a military operation, and hides in Erin's inn, talking to Bird, Numbtongue, and Erin, because he doesn't want to go. He's convinced to go anyway by General Shirka, and Chaldion bribes him into the attack on the Hivelands by offering to take six names of Turnscales off wanted lists and redirect the Watch's efforts for three months. Saliss, Mivifa of Feathers (Oteslia's Named Adventurer), Zeter (Manus' Named Adventurer), and a bunch of soldiers attack the Antinium hives and damage the Armored Queen's "Steelclad" project. Saliss fights Wrymvr and Klbktch, finding himself unable to kill Wrymvr. Klbktch gets chopped in half by Wrymvr on purpose, so the Queens can rebuild him. Saliss returns home and announces that he's going to make the antidote for the Strategists.

Meanwhile, the Couriers from first landing (including Mihaela Godfrey) attempt to deliver the cure to Tyrion and run into the top Assassins from the Guild. Lacel the Leaper and a Drake courier is killed, Mihaela is severely injured, and the delivery fails.

Ryoka takes Mrsha on a bike ride. Xrn has a conversation with Ryoka, in which she presses Ryoka for actual aid from the self-professed "ally" of the Antinium. Ryoka tells her Wistram is spying on the Queens through their scrying mirrors, and gives Xrn microscopes and knowledge of how to sterilize an area of bacteria (which mess with the Antinium Queens' experiments).

Numbtongue and Mrsha get into an argument over the laptop, and Lyonette is pulled into it, ending in a physical altercation in Invrisil. Zevara attempts to arrest the Gentlemen Callers, but Erin helps them escape. The Players of Celum finally convince Erin to attend their play in Invrisil, all the Earthers and mages from the Inn, as well as Ryoka, Fierre, Salamani, Numbtongue, Lyonette, Mrsha, and a lot of other friends of the inn (including Xrn in a human disguise). The Players set up a huge parade to celebrate, and the attention starts to make Erin feel socially awkward. At the Djinni's Spoon, Barelle the Bard tries to perform a song about her deeds, but she faints. She goes on a walk to clear her head and calm down, gets lost in the bad area of Invrisil, tries to stop a mugging, and finds some of the Brothers of Serendipitous Meetings. She follows them back to their hideout and chats with them, Wilovan, and Ratici, then invites them to come see the play with her. Afterwards, she returns to the Wandering Inn to discover that Badarrow and Snapjaw are there.

Bird reunites with Badarrow, Snapjaw meets Erin and is impressed with the free food. Ryoka, Fierre, and Salamani buy magic items, including a Golem, and Ryoka gives some magic gear to Mrsha, Bird, Badarrow, and Snapjaw. Ryoka discovers Tyrion Veltras' plea, and keeps wanting to investigate it despite everyone else telling her it's suicide. Persua accepts the delivery of the cure from Lady Ieka, who has recieved conflicting orders from the Circle. Ryoka brings Delanay d'Artien to the Wandering Inn. Selys meets Todi, who came to the Wandering Inn to try to get what the Horns of Hammerad, Halfseekers, and Griffon Hunt got from the inn, and she considers hiring his team.

An [Assassin] inspects Octavia's shop to make sure she's not making Tyrion's cure. Earl Altestiel of Desonis arrives in the inn, playing chess against Olsem and Erin, and has his [Strategist] take a mage-picture of Erin to send to Niers Astoragon (to ask if she's his chess partner). Xif and Saliss come to the inn, Xif haranguing Saliss about taking credit for the cure for the [Strategists] in Oteslia, before accidentally revealing that Saliss has been making the cure for Tyrion instead. Saliss kills a few [Assassins], then brings the cure to Invrisil's Runner's Guild.

Saliss promises to defend Invrisil's guild from [Assassins] for two hours, awaiting a runner to deliver the cure. Ryoka prepares to accept, and her friends try to stop her. Ryoka convinces her friends one-by-one not to stop her. Erin resolves to help Ryoka get out of the city, and Snapjaw asks Erin not to ask Numbtongue and Badarrow for help.

Many runners and Ryoka's friends join her plan to make a distraction while she sneaks into the Runner's Guild. Her plan immediately falls apart and she's captured, but Erin leads multiple armies into Invrisil through her door, including part of Pallass' 1st Army, Liscor's guard, human soldiers from the Lords she has trade deals with, and an army of Antinium lead by Xrn. Ryoka gets rescued, then grabs the cure from the Guild, only to discover once she's out of the city that the vial is just water. Saliss meets her with the real cure, along with Maviola, and they begin running for House Veltras. Maviola makes an appeal on the scrying orb, and a bunch of people start wrecking the assassins to help them escape (the Silver Swords and Lord Gralton). Belavierr, watching on the scrying orb, sends a rain of needles after Maviola. Ryoka, Maviola, and Saliss take cover, then transform into horses once the scrying spell cuts out.

Fierre drinks the blood of [Assassins] in Invrisil, and gains [Assassin] levels for the first time.

Ryoka, Maviola, and Saliss have four hours of reprive from their "transform into horses" gambit. As they're found again, and start fighting through more waves of [Assassins] while running, the Singer of Terandria co-opts the scrying broadcast to sing to them, granting them benefits from her Skills. Chaldion starts using his Skills on Saliss, and the King of Destruction grants them a [Greater Blessing of Armor] from afar. People from all over start using Skills and magic to influence the run. Archmage Viltach launches lightning at the assassins. When the [Assassins] cut the trio of runners off at a bridge, guarded by thousands more [Assassins] (a third of all the assassins on the continent), Saliss stays behind to take them all on, detonates all his potions, and uses his capstone skill: [Disable Friendly Fire].

Gresaria Wellfar attacks the Guild of Assassins in First Landing, and is immediately killed. The rest of the Five Families, [Sailors], etc, all attack and blow up their headquarters. Maviola El turns back to stop the [Assassins] using her new level 50 skill, trapping them in a burning forest filled with fire elementals. Only four Faces manage to escape, chasing Ryoka. Ryoka dons a glider and flies away, but the [Assassins] shoot at her and one of them is a Garuda. Mavika and Alevica come to help, delaying the [Assassins], and Ryoka summons Typhoon Erannda, killing one of the assassins in her escape. When she lands, three [Assassins] catch up to her. Tritel, Salamani, and Hawk intercept the assassins, killing one. Another fled. The third, Ferin, killed Tritel and Ci before running after Ryoka again. Tritel used a Skill to sacrifice himself to save Ci.

Ferin shoots Ryoka in the back with a crossbow, and Tyron Veltras arrives to take the cure. Ryoka is rushed to a [Healer], uncertain if she will survive, and Ferin is killed by Tyrion. Maviola El and Saliss both survived. Mihaela Godfrey declares Ryoka is a Courier.

The [Assassins] try to kill Farmer Lupp and Ryoka's friends in revenge. The Five Families kill them, and conduct a massive purge, blowing up their ships, unmasking and executing their agents with truth spells. House Veltras finds Mire the [Assassin]-[Alchemist] Face, and executes her in front of her family. Jericha (is implied to have) tortured the [Toxins Expert]. Half the leaders of the Circle of Thorns reveal that they were foreign adversaries that infiltrated the Circle.

Erin experiments with her new [Boon of the Guest] skill, giving people [Boon of Relc] and [Boon of Saliss]. Pawn and Xrn test his [Prayer: A Leaf in the Wind]. Fierre uses a new skill, [Body: Reject Toxins] to cough up more silver dust. Fetohep of Khelt orders bicycles from Solar Cycles (Kevin, Selys, Hedault, and Pelt's bike shop), and reveals that he knows Kevin is an Earther, inviting him to come to Khelt. Chaldion, Altestiel, Olsem, Bird, Erin, Niers (through the magic chessboard), and a bunch of others have a chess tournament. Troy starts giving tips to the Flying Gnoll of Pallass. Badarrow and Snapjaw buy out Octavia's stock of mana and healing potions for Goblinhome. Invrisil tries to poach Joseph for their football team. Hexel bolts the magic door to the wall and installs a truth stone in an arch above it, to check for [Assassins], and Lyonette hires him to help design stuff for the inn.

Krshia tells Erin it's time for the Meeting of Tribes, and wants to talk about Mrsha.

Krshia speaks with Erin and Lyonette about leaving for the Meeting of Tribes. Inkar, an Earther, reflects on the similarities between worlds, and how she came to be here, as the Longstalker's Fang Tribe marches toward the Meeting. While meeting the Greenpaw Tribe, Inkar is shown part of and airplane that fell from the sky. The two tribe's decide to work together as allies at the Meeting of Tribes. Two Drake Generals talk as their Army is halted, waiting for Gaarh Marsh, Khoteizetrough, Demas metal and other tribes to finish crossing paths. Lehra is pursued by Niila thru a drake town outside Zeres, before calling a truce to get away from Wall Lord Dragial. The Ekhtouch Tribe joins the camp in the middle of the night, and more of how The Meeting of Tribes works is explained. Plains Eye orders Mrsha's death after seeing her on WNN. Flos, speaking with his Gnoll's, has word sent to The Meeting of Tribes, he will grant land in exchange for service. Ilvriss talks to Allric about Salazsar possibly allying with Gnoll tribes.

Rabbiteater and the Knights try and break out but fail when General Yerzhen intervenes. Kids play "Attack Liscor" in the Inn and Erin sees their impression of her. Altestiel asks Erin permission to court her, over a game of chess, since he has been called home. Talia apologizes to Rabbiteater and tells him her family will pay his ransom. He tries to confess to the Knights, then asks Talia to remember her promise. The women of the Inn come out in force to help Erin get ready, give advice and relax, although Hexel relaxes her most of all. The Earl takes Erin for a walk above the Flood Plain on a water bridge, as they return Erin is bombarded by other suitors vying for her affection. A Runner comes to to take Erin to the Mages Guild to ransom Ser Solstice. Lasica talks to Garry about the competition, and standing, for Erin's affection. After settling the ransom Erin lets Altestiel down easy, over a game of Go, and witness's his sulking first hand... a little. Ser Solstice is grabbed by the mage and guards, who cast silence spells on the other Knights, and taken to find out who is under the helmet. Erin physically causes an earthquake throwing her [Boon of the Guest] to Rabiteater, just as the mage and guards attack. Ser Solstice fights his way out toward the other Knights where he is cut of by General Yershin, who challenges him to a dual. Zel coaches Rabbit through the fight, even keeping him from drawing blood, pointing out that its a dual not death. Sometime during the dual Ser Solstice's visor is stuck open, revealing his face, Ser Markus and Dame Talia see before Markus points it out to Rabbiteater.

Niers gathers his top advisors at breakfast with Foliana to announce his departure for vacation. Erin watchs as Kiish and two Knights have to body-check Altestiel into his carriage, to leave and go home. Erin warns The Callers that the door will be off line for a few hours for upgrades as they return from Invrisil. As Hexel starts to make the upgrades Erin rushes off to a funeral. When she returns she is in crazy plan mode. Niers scares Merxel popping out of a wine bottle,Erin talks to Laken, and a force of drakes closes in on Liscor. Niers arrives in the Flood Plains, the Antinium spread word of the attack forces, Todi and his team take note of the Gold ranks that just went to Esthelm. Ambushes outside Liscor and Esthelm, fighting outside the Inn, Erin gets hit with poisoned bolts and appears to die, but Kevin tells the mages to flash freeze her at the last second, and Niers is captured by a Razorbeak. WAR!!!!!!!

Erin is frozen and placed on a bier in the Garden, Krshia falls to the ground from her saddle, Tkrn howls, Rags sits and stares lost in time. Pawn, furious his Skill isnt working, tackles Garry, Maviola argues to put Erin to rest properly, Saliss has Montressa cast [Detect Life] while Numbtongue cast [Detect Death], both show nothing. Visma starts laughing, whispers to Mrsha and the kids point out Erin's Skills are still working. Hectval receives Liscor's message of war at the same time their 3rd Regiment is wiped out. Olesm's force strikes fast and hard, but inexperience and hot blood soon start to take a toll. Geneva helps lay out a plan, and agrees to come TRY to help. Hope, uncertainty, fear....RAGE. Maviola rushes to catch Liscors Army, Olesm struggles to maintain cohesion over all the rage. Ambush in the hills, word spreads and Hectval starts loosing allies. Maviola arrives with the door, Olesm summons the Black Tide. Olesm kills the enemy General, Maviola is captured by Belavierr, but killed by Az'Kerash mercifully.

Luan shows up the Bushrangers on a 30k march, before leaving on a delivery. Ryoka wakes up and learns of Erin and Maviola's deaths on the way to Riverfarm. Riverfarm is set, all the Nobles are present, Ryoka convinces The Players to put the performance of their life on as the party starts. Delanay tells Ryoka and Halrac everything as noon slowly approaches. Blackmage sits in his room, Luan runs from an ambush, Laken waits alone, the sun disappears. The Blighted King performs a ritual. The Fae arrive as fast as the eclipse fades. Aaron, Luan and Laken all have visitors of their own.

Othius conducts the ritual, in secret, far under ground. Lady Zanthia wears a heavy burden, a Frozen Warrior protects Lord Tourant’s son and Ryoka saves Sammy from a Satyr. Ryoka meets the first of 3 guests of importance: A Wyrm - traded for 2 questions, resisted her intimidation and stare. A Treant - Saves her from Sikeri, helps with wording of request to #3 in exchange for meeting Tyrion. Emerrhain greets Aaron by hand-shake and name before setting to work. Tamaroth holds Laken in his house, after Laken calls him on his trick, but also learns of the other's vulnerability. The Summer Court stop Ryoka before she can reach #3, free beer, statues and... corn... win them over? Melidore (#3) sits with Ryoka, Ieka, Mavika and Zedalien, for a repast before business. After forcing Melidore's boon, he opens a door to Avalon, causing the Frozen guards to attack. The Dancing Man sends Luan into a [Fireball]'s path when he is rejected. The Lost Thing breaks into the Garden, an army of Goblin ghosts protects Erin's body. The Wild Hunt is challenged to duels, Ryoka passes as Melidore howls in rage, the Summer Court get him to play the Green Knight. Four People approach the edge of the Fae's party in the wake of Ryoka disappearing. Ryoka enters Avalon

Ryoka arrives on a hill filled with flowers and monolithic gates to other worlds. While trying to organize her overstimulated thoughts, Ryoka stumbles on a fork in her clear path. City right - Forest left. The Winter Warrior pursues Ryoka and calls the Wild Hunt on her. The Four are denied from the party, barely. As Ryoka gets deeper into the forest everything changes, she learns perception is the key. As the rituals power builds, the mages feel something is off. As Ryoka starts to understand, a giant tries to eat her before Nama saves her. When she enters they city she finds magnificent ruins. The Four force their way in, the Fae start to fight. Ryoka runs into a Kid outside a pub, he tells her not to enter, Nama saves her when she flees the bugs. Ulvama prepares to leave, Aaron hurries his work and Ryoka meets 3 Arthurs around a familiar stone. Nama shows Ryoka her destination, Tyrion rallies everyone to help the Fae and Ryoka meets 3 Wyrms, a Squad of Toy Soldiers and Ivolethe. After thanking Nama properly, the pair fly, Ivolethe buries Belavierr and Az'kerash in snow, and talk about Erin. The Soldiers trade with the Kid for a "Stick", and Ryoka gets the Arthurs' autographs. Back at the gates Ryoka realizes its a graveyard, not a garden of flowers. Numbtongue finds Reiss guarding Erin's body surrounded by goblin statues that shouldn't have been there. Melidore traps The Five, and calls for his KING. The Ritual, the Gateway, The Five, the Fae, it all mixes and twists the magic, Othius addresses Earth. Ryoka and Ivolethe sneak back through the portal into a Vault. One text message "The Gods are alive" Oberon retreats, he offers to send Ryoka back to Earth, Ivolethe tells her a tiny part of the prophecy and Oberon gives her a plastic dagger and tells her to seek out Goblins before she goes through the portal. Ryoka comes out of the sky in the middle of the party, The Ritual worked at a cost. Othius asked for all the children except of Rhir to be sacrificed since he feels he has fought alone for so long. The Meeting of Tribes begins. Lyonette decides to go to Oteslia and Ulvama barges in as the Magical door is checked.

title: Murder on the Orient Express
author: Agatha Christie
summary:
Murder on the Orient Express Agatha Christie Hercule Poirot #10 Murder on the Orient Express Summary

Hercule Poirot has just done some favor for the French army in Syria, and now is headed back home. He boards the Taurus express to Istanbul, where the only other passengers in his car are two English people, Mary Debenham and Colonel Arbuthnot. He overhears some strange conversations between the two of them on the journey. He had planned to spend a few days in Istanbul before boarding his next train but gets a telegram that means he has to hurry home.

He runs into an old friend, Monsieur Bouc (An executive of the Wagons-Lits train company), who is also headed west and helps him get a second-class room on the surprisingly full Orient Express. Hercule is sharing a room with a young American named Hector McQueen.

Throughout the first day Poirot observes the various passengers, who include Mary and the Colonel from the Taurus express. McQueen works for a man named Ratchet, who has an evil face and Poirot dislikes. Ratchet approaches Poirot to ask for protection since he feels in danger, and Poirot refuses him.

Before bed, M. Bouc moves to a different car and gives Hercule his old first-class berth so he has his own room, right next to Ratchet’s. In the night he wakes up at 1:23 am when he hears a gasp from next door. He opens his door and the conductor, Pierre Michel, checks on Ratchet, who responds in French he is fine. The man then tells Hercule they are stopped due to a snow drift, and brings him a mineral water. A while later there is frantic buzzing from the room 2 down and an american lady, Mrs. Hubbard, is screaming there is a man in her room but when the conductor comes no one is there. Later Hercule awakens to a thump at his door and when he checks sees a woman in a red kimono fleeing down the hall.

The following morning M. Bouc summons Hercule and he meets a Dr. Constantine and learns Ratchet is dead and was stabbed twelve times, seemingly at different times with different hands and different amounts of force. The window was left open, but the train is still stopped and there are no footprints in the snow, so they know the murderer is still on the train. Hercule finds a couple of clues in Ratchet’s compartment. A pipecleaner, a handkerchief with the letter “H”, and a mostly burned note with the words “Armstrong” and “Girl” on them. Poirot connects this to the Armstrong kidnapping in America, the daughter of a famous actress and her husband, a Colonel Armstrong, had their young girl kidnapped and held ransom, then found dead when they paid. The mother had a miscarriage and died from grief, the Colonel was a broken man, and the maid killed herself after intensive police questioning. The man “Ratchet” was actually Cosetti, who carried out the kidnapping but escaped justice due to legal technicalities.

Poirot, Bouc, and the Doctor now interview everyone in the train car, since it has to have been one of them.

Pierre Michel - The car conductor, confirms what Hercule saw last night. Sat in a bench at the end of the car most of the night.

Hector McQueen - Secretary to Ratchet, father was the DA in the Armstrong case, speaks multiple languages since Ratchet only spoke english. He was with Colonel Arbuthnot the time the murdered occured (12-2am according to the doctor, and a broken watch found saying 1:15).

Masterman - The valet to Ratchet, was awake all night with a toothache. Vouches for his Italian bunkmate. Says he gave ratchet a sleeping draft since he always takes on on a train.

Detective Hardman - An american who was pretending to be a typewriter salesman, is actually a detective from New York. Says Ratchet hired him to watch for an attacker, a small man with a womanish voice. He had an end compartment and confirms no one entered or left, so the murderer had to be in this train car.

Mrs. Hubbard - A flighty, dramatic american woman who found a conductor uniform button in her room, probably from the man she heard in the night. Her room and Ratchets had a connecting door, which she claims a swedish lady says was locked before bed but was unlocked in the morning.

Greta Ohlson - The Swedish lady. She confirms Hubbards story, and since she shares a room with Mary Debonham, says neither left their compartment last night

Antonio - The Italian, confirms what Masterman said.

Princess Dragomirov - An old lady without the strength to stab a man, however she was the god-mother to Mrs. Armstrong, the woman from the kidnapping.

Hildegard Schmidt - The handmaid to the princess, says around midnight she was bringing something to her lady, when she ran into a small man with a womanish voice in a conductor’s uniform leaving Ratchet’s compartment. But when shown all the conductors says it is none of them.

Count and Countess Andrenyi - Recently wed travelling dignitaries.

Hercule performs various tests to see if the pipe cleaner and handkerchief belong to anyone, and what hand is dominant, etc. After interviewing everyone he goes and searches luggage and finds nothing, except a rolled up conductors uniform in Hildegard’s baggage, which she claims is not hers, and the red kimono in his own luggage at the end.

Hercule, Dr. Constantine, and M. Bouc do some thinking, and Hercule solves it. He explains a few things to the others and begins to call people back in, and ask them why they lied and explain their connection to the armstrong case. Mary Debonham was a nurse to the girl Daisy Armstrong, and is in love with Colonel Arbuthnot. Antonio was their Chauffeur. Masterman was Col. Armstrong’s valet. McQueen was their secretary. Hildegaard was their maid, etc.

They gather all of the passengers in the dining car and Hercule Poirot says he has two theories for this murder. Theory 1: A man snuck onto a train when they stopped at a station at midnight and stabbed Ratchet and left unseen. Dr. Constantine is upset and says this is not possible, but Poirot says to wait. Theory 2: Every single passenger in the train was connected to the Armstrong case. This is not coincidence, it is intentional. They all stabbed Ratchet/Cossetti since he should never have been free. Mrs. Hubbard, the mother of Mrs. Armstrong in disguise, basically confirms and it and says she will take the blame. But instead they all agree the second theory is wrong and everyone will tell the police the first theory. Hercule Poirot solved it. THE END.

title: The Looking Glass Wars
author: Frank Beddor
summary:
The Looking Glass Wars Frank Beddor The Looking Glass Wars #1 The Looking Glass Wars Summary

Alyss Heart, Princess of Wonderland, is having her 7th birthday party. She and her mother, Queen Genevieve, are watching the inventors parade. Wonderlanders invent stuff and, if it is interesting, the Queen can send it into the Heart Crystal, and it will inspire people in other worlds. When Alyss gets bored she uses her imagination to affect the real world. It is a power of the royal family and Alyss has a very strong imagination. They are waiting for King Nolan to get back from meeting with King Arch of the neighboring kingdom of Boarderland.

Alyss is being trained to be responsible, since Wonderland is a Queendom and she will be it’s next ruler. The tutor Bibwit Harte, a large albino man, has trained the queens for generations. Alyss and her best friend, Dodge Anders, son of the captain of the guard, are often getting into trouble. While playing together Jack of Diamonds, a ten year old boy and heir to the Jack family, interrupts them and they run. They flee the city to the Pool of Tears, a magic pond/lake that anyone who jumps in is teleported somewhere else. No one has ever returned from it.

While King Nolan is coming home, he is ambushed by Redd, Genevieve’s vicious older sister who started a civil war 13 years ago and is now returned. Her and her card soldiers kill the king and advance on Wonderland. Queen Genevieve has retreated to her sitting room with her only guard, Hatter Maddigan, a member of the Millinery (elite special forces with a hat that can turn into blades). They meet the Blue Caterpillar, smoking oracles. He warns her something is wrong but it is confusing.

In a tea room, all the nobles are gathered when Redd attacks. Her best assassin, The Cat, who can transform between small normal cat and giant cat humanoid, attacks and distracts Hatter and kills Dodge’s father, Justice Anders. Alyss hides under the table and sees the cat scratch Dodge, leaving 4 scars on his face. The Queen, Alyss, and Hatter flee. The suit families immediately submit to Redd. Hatter kills The Cat, then him and Alyss jump into the Crystal Continuum, a portal transport system connecting most mirrors. Genevieve smashes the mirror behind them. Redd shows up, they fight with their imaginations but Redd is stronger and beheads Genevieve. The Cat comes back to life since he has nine lives.

Hatter and Alyss flee to the Pool of Tears and jump in, with The Cat right behind them. The Cat returns and tells Redd he killed them. Very few people escaped, those loyal to “White Imagination” vs. Redd’s “Black Imagination”, and they gather under general DoppelGanger (Who can split in 2 then 4), and some chess piece soldiers. They call themselves Alyssians in memory of Alyss.

Hatter and Alyss get separated in the water and Alyss pops out of a puddle in London and Hatter in Paris. Hatter begins a worldwide journey to find Alyss, learning how to use puddles to reenter wonderland via the pool of tears. Alyss befriends a local orphan named Quigly Gaffer and his gang, and makes money by using her imagination to make a flower sing. But the longer she is on Earth the less she can do and eventually they are forced to steal food. Alyss is caught and sent to an orphanage before being adopted by the Liddells. Mr. Liddell is dean of Christchurch college, and her adopted sisters make fun of her stories of Wonderland.

Dodge, General Doppelganger, and chessmen such as the White Rook continue to be an underground guerilla resistance, but Redd mostly controls Wonderland. She has turned it into a bit of a slum and forces Bibwit Harte to replace ancient books. Dodge is only set on vengeance against The Cat and has no regard for his own life.

Alyss meets Reverend Charles Dodgson, who seems to believe her story, but then publishes Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland as Lewis Carroll, and she is so angry and distraught she vows never to think of Wonderland again. She becomes a standup young lady of England and makes her new family proud. Eventually catching the eye of and agreeing to marry Prince Leopold, youngest son of Queen Victoria. Hatter sees the book about Alice and now knows where to find her, but when he gets close a soldier shoots him, and he retreats to Wonderland to heal.

Dodge finds Hatter coming out of the Pool of Tears and helps him to the Alyssians base. Jack of Diamonds is trying to convince them to agree to a meeting with Redd. He has been a self serving double agent for both sides for years. The rebels are overjoyed to see Hatter and learn of Alyss. Jack hurries off to tell Redd. Since Hatter is hurt Dodge goes to retrieve Alyss. When Redd learns Alyss is alive she kills The Cat in anger and sends him and soldiers to finish the job.

On her wedding day to Leopold, The Cat and a group of robotic card soldiers called The Cut attack. Dodge rushes Alice to safety, and they flee to the Pool of Tears. They are pursued by The Cat but make it safely back to the Alyssian camp. Alyss is overwhelmed by everything. She had almost convinced herself Wonderland was not real, and her imagination does not work. Bibwit Harte also defects back to their side. Alyss and Dodge go to see the old Heart Palace, which is in disrepair. Redd senses them and destroys the palace.

While Dodge and Alyss are out, Jack of Diamonds leads The Cat and soldiers to the camp and they attack. Alyss and Dodge return, and them, Hatter, general Doppelganger, Bibwit Harte, the White Rook, and few others escape into the Crystal Continuum. Redd orders all mirrors smashed and the continuum begans to shrink, they barely escape out a mirror in the volcanic fire lands, where they are attacked by a Jabberwocky and forced to flee. They are headed to the Valley of Mushrooms to see the Caterpillar oracles.

The Blue Caterpillar tells Alyss where the Looking Glass Maze is in a riddle. It is the hereditary test of queens to make them ready to rule. Alyss has slowly been regaining her imagination powers. They head to Wonderland city and meet a young girl, Homburg Molly. Hatter dislikes her because she is a “Halfer”, half Milliner half civilian. They flee to a puzzle shop with soldiers on their tales and Alyss enters the Looking Glass maze.

She encounters visions of herself, her parents, and her worst memories. She is forced to fight and be a good person and eventually reaches a white scepter and is ejected from the maze. She is now mega powerful and kills all of the attacking soldiers at once. Her group plans an attack on Mt. isolation, where Redd rules.

Alyss summons a ton of tiny fake soldiers as a distraction and they all sneak in the back. Dodge races off to find The Cat and the others split up. Dodge ends up in a battle with The Cat and takes more of his lives. Alyss finds Redd and they begin to battle. It is fairly even but Redd is on the offensive. The Cat is about to kill Dodge, so Alyss summons an AR52 (card assault rifle) into his hands, but gets knocked out in the process. She wakes up back in London, her family saying she was dreaming, but Dodge makes her realize it is a trick. She snaps out and fights Redd, dominating her this time. Alyss’ team seems to have almost won, and they break Redds scepter. She jumps into the Heart Crystal, and The Cat, on his last life, follows. No one knows what exactly this means.

Alyss creates a duplicate of herself to go back to Earth and appease her family. And her and her group begin to try to rebuild Wonderland. THE END.

title: Elevation of Mana: A Progression Fantasy
author: Wandering Agent
summary:
Elevation of Mana Wandering Agent Elevation of Mana #1 Elevation of Mana Summary

Justin is a college student studying some science tech stuff. While walking home one day he gets trapped in a mysterious forest glade and spends about a month there, trying not to eat or drink the water and fruit, but eventually caves and gives in. He suffers immense pain then is reborn as an elven baby in a elf world, but retains all his young adult memories from Earth.

As a baby he studies the world around him, and tries to learn about the various forms of magic and the elven language. He grows up in a small village led by the village elder, Alea, and the village is called Alea-toll. The world seems to be operating in the hunting-gathering stone age. Justin, now renamed Elian by his elf family, has strong magic, called “Light” by the elves. He has magic like Alea, they can affect the elements and world around them, but nothing living. His father has a music based magic, where he can sing and affect the world. He is especially good at shaping stone. His mother is like a druid, and can make plants grow.

As he grows up he plans to bring this world into the “modern” age. He starts by introducing pottery to his Aunt and she takes up the practice. He trains in his magic and learns how to hunt and fish with the other boys of the village. Elves don’t have children often. When Elian is eight or so a big bear attacks the village and he helps them kills it. One of the only other magically powerful people in the village besides his parents and Alea is a hunter named Lorus, who can do like body enhancement magic. Not much happens besides him getting to know the villagers and continue to master his magic.

Alea is summoned to Ah-tol, the biggest city in the area led by the ancient Ah. As elves age they get more and more powerful, and each elder leads a village, like Alea. She returns and tells them a cold season is coming. They only get winter every 10-30 years on this world. Some Twilight monsters attack the villagers and destroy a lot of their supplies. Elian had tried to introduce meat storage by digging a hole and conjuring ice on the walls. They survive the winter and move on.

Elian finds copper being sold by a wandering merchant and introduces metal working to the world, becoming the premier blacksmith through much trial and error. By this point he is 14ish. Teenager. Him and his father go to a neighboring village to a known copper deposit. On the way their he sees the “valley” he grew up in is a actually a crater, and right at the center of it is a cave he knows that has power emanating from it. A girl in the tribe, Isha is his friend, but he keeps rebuffing her advances because he feels weird since his mental age feels 20 years older. Him, Isha, Rendall (another boy in the village who does not like Elian), and Rendall’s girlfriend go to a cave where they sheltered during the twilight beast attack. They delve deeper, and find an underground forest area, much like the one Justin was trapped in on Earth. They also find Dragon bones. Rendall drinks from the water and almost dies so they rush him home.

Alea and Elian get into a fight, since Alea knew the water was dangerous but told no one. Elian’s mom, who already did not like Alea, tells him that her and his father are both close to being considered elders, and when they do they will leave the village to start their own.

Rendall gained magic from drinking the water and is very strong, but Alea says he only has a few years to live and using the magic will rush that death. He ignores her and keeps using it frivolously. Eventually, Rendall takes a group of children and his lady back to the pool to drink from it and gain power. Elian chases them down and tries to talk Rendall out of this idea, but Rendall attacks him and Elian ends up killing him, but starts a forest fire in the process.

They have a tribe meeting, and Alea banishes Elian, as well as Rendall’s bereaved girlfriend. His mom is furious, and promises him that as soon as possible they will be leaving and he is welcome back then. He agrees, but decides to head to Ah-tol and see what the world has to offer. His trek to the big city is uneventful.

He buys a house for a single copper knife, and sets up a workshop. He hires a young street rat to spread new tech like pottery and woodworking techniques. We get a side scene of the man who sold him the house meeting with Ah, the elder/ancient, and we see that Ah just wants new weaponry. He is violent. Elian also wants to abolish the slave trade in the city. Nothing else really happens. The end.

title: Empire of the Dawn
author: Jay Kristoff
summary:
Empire of the Dawn Jay Kristoff Empire of the Vampire #3 Empire of the Dawn Summary

Jean-Francois goes to see his empress, Margot Chastain. The Draigann, now priori of the Dyvok, has just arrived to Sul Adair. The Dyvok are very excited for Gabriel’s execution, but Margot still wants to hear the rest of the story of the grail first, hoping to learn why Fabien Voss wanted Dior alive. Jean-Francois warns her he thinks both Gabriel and Celene are lying, but she tells him to continue in gathering the tale. When he returns to Gabe’s tower he finds “Dario” (Joaquin Maren) lying on the ground, almost drained of blood. Him and Gabe return to the story.

Gabe left Dun Maergenn before Dior’s funeral, but not before draining three vials of her blood. He sets out with his horse Argent to hunt down and kill the Forever King, Fabien Voss. His Sangire (Blood lust) is growing stronger by the day, and Ashdrinker seems to be getting more crazy, forgetting who he is at times. He gets jumped by some wretched but Lachlan, Aaron, and Baptiste show up to save him and say they are coming with him on the hunt. Baptiste warns Gabriel that Ashdrinker’s core is cracked, meaning she is close to breaking completely. She can’t be fixed, but in order to patch her temporarily they head to Leon, the city/baronny where Gabe’s mother grew up and was kicked out of when she got pregnant with him.

On the trip things between Baptiste and Aaron degenerate. Baptiste wants Aaron to drink his blood, both for the feeling of the kiss and because Aaron needs it. Aaron refuses because he does not want to feel like a monster. Lachlan also hates Aaron for being a vampire. They get close to the city of Leon, and see a group of wretched chasing a young woman. Lachlan and Gabe ride to help her, but she screams at them to stay away (they ignore her). Lachlan falls in a pit trap full of spikes meant for the vampires, and a group of soldiers with flaming crossbows pops up and slaughter the wretched vampires. The woman is Charlotte de Leon, The ashen lion, and Gabriel’s cousin. She seems to hate Gabe and especially Aaron but takes them as prisoners to Leon to meet the Baron (Gabe’s Grandfather). They arrive in a city that seems untouched by the war Fabien Voss is leading on humans. They go to a grand feast with wine (Expensive) and the baron, Gerrard, says they are welcome to his home and invites them to eat and drink.

In the following days, Aaron is forced to stay in a stable, and they go and meet the forgemaster Cortez, who says he can do some welding on Ashdrinker. Going to church is mandatory and there is holy water in every door. We learn a few years ago vampires had infested the city, and Charlotte burned down half of it to eradicate them, hence her nickname, lion cendree. The baron says he sent many letters begging his daughter to return but she was stubborn and never came back, then he asks gabe to take over as Baron after he dies. Fabien Voss is going to march on Augustine, capital of the empire, soon, but they have not gone to help since the emperor died recently from sickness, only Isabella sits the throne now. Gabe feels something is off about this city.

Gabe finds Baptiste cheating on Aaron with forgemaster Cortez, and Lachlan seems to be falling in love with Charlotte despite his vows to the silver order. Gabe is distracted though with his bloodlust, being tempted by the young serving maid each night in his room. Eventually he breaks and forces her to leave, in the process shattering on of Dior’s blood vials, drinking a few drops, and seeing a strange vision. He floats above the empire, and sees the symbols of vampire over each part of it (ravens where the Voss are, Snake over the are he is in, and a giant hand rising from Charbourg (city where the redeemer died 1,000 years ago) grabbing the black sun).

Aaron seems to freak out after learning about Baptiste and not having blood, and flees the city. The next day Gabe goes to look for everyone and finds them in church, bowed before a vampire. Ilon, the oldest of his bloodline, one of the five priests who betrayed the redeemer and killed him. He has been controlling this city for generations, using his bloodline powers to manipulate and thrall everyone here. Gabe is immune to being thralled because of Dior’s blood, but Ilon does not know this and thinks he will be able to control him. They fight, and Aaron flies in to help at the perfect moment and another vial of Dior’s blood shatters, freeing Charlotte who stabs Ilon, then the Baron ignites the blade, burning Ilon but being killed in the process. Charlotte is now acting baroness of Leon and agrees to march with the silversaints. Gabe retrieves a journal of his mothers from the barons coat, but it is partly soaked in blood so will be hard to read. They patch Ashdrinker and set out. Before leaving Gabe insinuates that he drank and killed the serving girl from his room.

Jean-Francois is notified that Kestrel Voss, priori of her line since Gabe killed Fabien, is nearly here, ahead of schedule. He moves back to Celene to learn more of Dior since Celene said Dior opened her eyes after the funeral. He first drenches her small prison island in oil and says any words or actions he dislikes he will burn her.

Mother Maryn is awake, but still sleepy and almost killed Celene upon waking. They hear thumping and go and free Dior from her coffin. Calling her resurrection a miracle the people are amazed and even more want to follow her. Dior wants to wait for Gabe and Maryn sends out a moth to find him but says they must leave soon. Mother Maryn fully explains the prophecy: Dior must be crowned empress on the throne in Augustin on a certain day (like a month out), with the redeemers sword. Another Esani vampire has been sleeping beneath Augustin guardian the sword, so they must head there and retrieve it. Phoebe can not convince the duskdancer army of the Moonsthrone to stay and help, they retreat to their homeland to discuss things. Joaquin now leads “The Unbound”, those soldiers Dior’s blood freed who are now super loyal to her. They plan to board the last ship in harbor and sail to Augustine.

One the voyage, Dior and Reyne become closer, but Reyne is still hesitant to do anything with Dior due to her religious upbringing. Phoebe deduces that Reyne’s father was likely Connor, her now dead husband, the wolf who killed Lilildh and saved Reyne. Phoebe and Reyne keep training Dior in the sword during the day, and at night Celene trains Dior in sanguimancy. They make a trade where every time Dior accomplishes something Celene will share more about her past. We learn how Celene awoke as a vampire to find her village slaughtered, when some bandits showed up she drank one of them and fled, vowing never to drink from a human again. Living on rodents, she made her way to San Yves, where she knew Wulfric (Gabe’s vampire father) lived.

Celene found Wulfric, who was living in secret under the city and training two Liathes, Aleks and Percival. Celene was taught the basics of their faith and eventually brought out to drink and kill sinners. Once she had more free time she fell in love watching the son of the towns baron, Laurent. He is blind, and she would listen to him play piano then they would talk. Celene was eventually given her first chance at “Communion”, when the Esani drink another vampire and absorb their powers and some memories. It was at a ball at the Barons house, and Celene disobeyed Wulfric’s orders to save Laurent from another vampire.

The ship Dior and Celene are on gets attacked by Voss vampire ships, and Mother Maryn shows her strength and singlehandedly kills an entire ships crew. They fight off the others and head to the river leading to Augustine, fearing they may be too late. Celene and Maryn have to be put in coffins since they are traveling over a fresh water river and vampires die if they do that unprotected. As they near, they see Augustin is attacked by Fabien Voss’ army, thousands and thousands of vampires. Their boat gets sunk and Joaquin saves the coffins of both Celene and Maryn. They all wade into battle.

Dior uses her blood to heal everyone they come across, and they are starting to make a real dent in the army, especially with Maryn and Celene. Then Kestrel Voss shows up, one of the princes of forever. She almost kills Reyne, and in a rage Dior turns into a giant wolf and bites off her hand. Voss orders a retreat, despite still seeming to have the advantage. Dior’s blood is able to save Reyne again though, but she is clearly a duskdancer. Since duskdancer children don’t gain the power until their parent is dead, they realize sometime between Dior hurting her hand (she only has a thumb and forefinger on her left hand), and lilidh snapping her neck, her parent died. This means that Connor was Dior’s father, making her and Reyne half-sisters.

Dior, Reyne, and Phoebe are led by Prince Philip to meet the empress Isabella. Dior keeps using her blood to help people in the city and they love her. Isabella is sceptical upon hearing Dior is the holy grail, and many in court call it heresy. Isabella then tells them they found and killed the vampire under Augustin a while ago, and gave the sword he kept to gabriel. Ashdrinker is the sword they need to complete the prophecy and end Dayseath.

Jean-Francois goes back to Gabe.

Gabe, Lachlan, Aaron, Baptiste, Charlotte, and 20,000 soldiers of Leon head toward San Maximille, the last place Fabien was confirmed to be. On the way they are joined by a few more silversaints who agree to help. Gabriel reads his mothers journal and learns about his father, but also that Wulfric seemed to want to “end the blackened veil” before daysdeath began, which causes him to question what the Esani vampires really want. On the march Gabe drank and killed a soldier of the army. As they near San Maximille they find and free a large group of humans being marched to feed Voss vampire soldiers. They find Fabien Voss has taken and camped in San Maximille after retreating from Augustin and set up camp to attack him the next day, when Phoebe shows up. She tells Gabe Dior is alive and that they need Ashdrinker for the prophecy and asks him to come to Augustin. He says he will come once he kills Voss.They sleep together and Phoebe steals Ashdrinker and flees in the night, but Gabe decides to attack anyway.

They make it to the keep, but Fabien had kept wretched in reserve and flanked them, killing the other silver saints and ordering Kestrel and another prince, Etienne, to stand down instead of killing Aaron and Lachlan. Fabien wants to talk, and then shows Gabriel Patience, his daughter had been brought back as a vampire and living with the Voss this whole time. Gabe is heartbroken and agrees. Fabien promising to tell him the Esani’s true goal. He enters the keep to discuss.

In the tower of Sul Adair with Jean-Francois, Gabe seems to be losing it and asks to drink blood from the servant Meline. With the vampire and servant distracted Gabe steals her silver blade and stabs the historian, burning him almost to death but then killing all the thrall swords and leaving.

Jean-Francois waits, gravely injured but alive, with Margot as Kestrel Voss arrives. She asks where the Draigann is and figures out that Gabriel has escaped and goes to chase and kill him. Margot is pissed, and orders Jean-Francois to go learn more from Celene, then turns into a wolf and takes off to hunt Gabe.

Celene tells how after the battle at Augustin, Maryn’s moth found Gabe and the army from Leon, so they sent Phoebe to meet him. Dior has spent the time helping the city. At a banquet one night she reveals to Isabella that she will need to be crowned empress for the prophecy. Reyne suggests she wed Prince Philip to accomplish this, which the empress and court can accept. Dior is angry and her and Reyne fight. They have mixed feelings because they love each other but are sisters and that is weird.

Celene comes to comfort Dior and tells her the end of her story. After she saved Laurent in San Yves, her and her Esani companions (Wulfric, Aleks, and Percival) had to flee since Aleks was caught and burned badly. But they are followed and Aleks and Percival get killed. Celene helps Wulfric flee, then hides in the city before returning to say goodbye to Laurent, but Wulfric shows up. He followed her and blames her for the others deaths. They fight and she ends up drinking him to death, without learning much the Esani have to teach. Laurent feels her true face and screams and she runs away. Dior feels bad for her.

Maryn brings Celene out of the city and they meet Phoebe, where we learn Maryn thralled her and forced her to steal ashdrinker. Celene breaks Ash even more since they can’t let her tell Dior what happened, then they go meet the court and Maryn/Phoebe tells the court that Gabe has joined the forever king since they have his daughter patience. Dior is confused and distraught but Maryn says they must proceed with the wedding. Philip and Dior are not happy, but understand it is necessary.

Dior is living on holy ground now, so Celene can not spy on her. She follows Reyne as she goes to talk to her sister who arrived recently. Reyne learns her and Dior are not sisters, Reyne’s father was someone else. She is super excited and runs to find Dior, but spies Gabe sneaking through the palace. She goes to talk to him but Maryn shows up and Gabe fights her, trying to tell Reyne what the Esani want. Some guards show up and Maryn kills all of them then kills Reyne, and blames it all on gabe.

Gabe gets caught and locked in a tower for torture. Dior is very very angry about Reyne and threatens to kill him, but Phoebe stops her. They decide they must go on with the wedding and coronation. Celene dives into her own mind during the wedding ceremony and asks Wulfric’s spirit what the Esani prophecy actually does, and learns it does not end Daysdeath, but ends the entire world. The Esani hoped to avoid being damned this way.

Jean-Francois is summoned to the throneroom, and finds Margot, with a burned face, and a bloody, barely alive Gabriel de Leon on the floor. He lost an eye but Margot did not kill him. The Draigann is furious and wants to kill him, as does Kestrel, but Kariim Ilon, Ilon Priori, shows up and convinces them to wait for tomorrow so it can be a spectacle. Jean-Francois is given charge of Gabe and told to get the story no matter what. Jean-Francois brings Gabe to Celene’s prison so they can all continue the story together.

Gabe, Charlotte, Lachlan, Aaron, and Baptiste meet with the Forever king and he tells them the Esani want to end the world. He also hints that he caused Daysdeath, then reveals Charlotte is pregnant with Lachlan’s child. Gabe goes to sing Patience to sleep then agrees to march to Augustin with Fabien to stop Celene and Maryn. Lachlan and Charlotte take the Leon troops and return home.

Maryn threatens Celene to hold her tongue, but during the reception Celene tells Dior. Dior reveals the knife pressed to Celene’s heart and says by confessing she saved herself, then a knight in armor cuts off Maryn’s head, and is revealed to be Gabe. Dior and Gabe hug and Phoebe is freed of Maryn’s control. They all reveal the truth to the court of what the Esani really wanted. Gabe and Dior had talked in secret the night before and figured out Phoebe was a thrall and set up the trap.

Fabien Voss then attacked Augustin. They humans marshalled their defenses, but since he can read minds he dodged a lot of them. A big battle ensues, where Gabe kills Etienne Voss, but Kestrel beheads Phoebe. Gabe almost dies but Lachland and Charlotte show up with the Leon troops and save him and help the battle, but then Kestrel kills Charlotte and Lachlan, and is about to get Gabe when Dior’s plan works and the air is filled with holy water mist, killing almost all the wretched and only a few highbloods escape.

Meanwhile in Fabien’s camp, Aaron and Baptiste learn that Fabien plans to use Dior’s blood to manually change humans into high blood vampires, and he leaves to capture her. Aaron is able to escape but Baptiste remains and wants to become a vampire to live with Aaron.

Despite it seeming like a victory in Augustin, Fabien shows up, kills Prince Philip, and kidnaps Dior. Gabriel goes to see Empress Isabella but she is sad and angry and tells him to go, so with few supplies him and Aaron set off to Charbourg in pursuit of Voss. Joaquin comes with them. Celene is chasing after them also.

Gabe’s sangire is getting really bad, and Aaron promises to kill him when this is all over. One night Joaquin cuts himself and Gabe attacks and starts drinking him but Aaron stops him, they force Joaquin to leave. They arrive to Charbourg and find huge rents in the ground, emitting black smoke and presumably causing Daysdeath. In a shattered cathedral they find Dior bound to a wheel and bleeding. They attack Fabien but he is strong and despite taking a few injuries burns both Baptiste and Aaron to death, then forces gabe to drink Dior’s blood which will turn him into a vampire. But it does not work. Voss was betrayed by the devil, and his daughter Morgane tells him he is stupid and mentally sends Gabe a message right before Fabiens kills her. Gabe and Celene then work together and attack Fabien, managing to kill him, with Celene drinking his power, but when he dies Patience is thrown into Dior’s blood and dies, and Gabe is trapped under rubble, slowly dying. Dior runs up and makes him drink her blood, and in his bloodlust Gabe kills Dior.

Jean-Francois is shocked. Nicolette, the Chastain ambassador, trapped both Gabe and Celene right after the fight when they were weak and brought them back here. Gabe and Celene both seem defeated and sad, and are bound before being brought to the throne room to be killed soon. Jean-Francois beings the account to Margot who reads it and is pleased. When returning to his room, Jean-Francois runs into Kestrel Voss and asks about Patience, but is confused when Kestrel said she died 4 years ago at Fabien’s hand. Him and Dario return to his room and he puts everything together. A white moth he has been seeing must be someone using Sanguimancy, and “Dario”, who Nicolette just happened to find must be Joaquin. They fight and Joaquin stalls him a while but ends up dying. Jean-Francois races to his empress, but there are so many vampires watching Celene and Gabe fight it is hard.

Suddenly, thousands of white moths flood into the room as highland war drums are heard outside. The moth forms a massive white wolf and Gabe unlocks himself and Celene. Dior wolf sprays her blood around the room, burning vampires, then jumps up and kills Margot Chastain, and all the other Priori die as well. Jean-Francois flees, and out a window sees Phoebe, Aaron, and Lachlan leading the attack. He realizes everything has been a lie and goes to hide in Celene’s cell. Gabe and Celene are led to him by Nicolette, who is Celene’s thrall. They reveal that much of the story was a lie, meant to stall until Dior could train with the highlanders and lead an army here. Morgane, before dying, told Gabe that Voss started Daysdeath with the blood of all 5 priori’s, and by killing them it may end. Gabe throws Jean-Francois into the prison island Celene was on and they leave him. It is a happy reunion with most of our cast still alive and happy. Dior’s blood can cure sickness and helped heal Gabe’s bloodlust. As they all stand outside they notice the sun is starting to get brighter. THE END.

title: Starship Troopers
author: Robert A. Heinlein
summary:
Starship Troopers Robert A. Heinlein Starship Troopers Summary

Johnny Rico is a member of the Mobile Infantry in a futuristic military. He and his squad, Ratjack’s Roughnecks, are aboard the boat (space ship) the Roger Young. They get dropped in capsules onto the planet below, inhabited by “Skinnies”, an alien race. Every member of the team is in powered armor suits, capable of unleashing devastating weaponry (multiple atomic bombs, etc.), and covering vast distances rapidly. He has recently been promoted to a command position. Their lieutenant, Ratjack, died (“bought it”) on their last mission and the sergeant Jelly is taking over. Johnny helps another squad leader, Ace, carry a wounded man, Dizzy< to the ship for pickup, despite Ace telling him not to. Jelly comes to help and they all make it out, although Dizzy dies on the way up.

We go back in time to his childhood, where Johnny grew up wealthy and his best friend Carl is a smart electrician kid. Carl says he is going to join the military, and Johnny decides to do it also although they both know his rich father won’t let him, and plans to send him to Harvard and take over the company business. Shortly after they graduate and turn 18, a female friend Carmen sees them and says she is going to join up, and Johnny makes the snap decision to do it also. His parents are enraged and is mostly cut off from them. He gets assigned to the Mobile Infantry (MI), and quickly begins to associate with them, as “The real army”.

Johnny gets sent to camp Arthur Curry in the North Pole (I think) for boot camp training. It is incredibly intense, with students dying and many more dropping out. Sergeant Zim is their instructor and he seems a cruel man at first. One trainee is given 10 lashes and dishonorably discharged for striking Zim. Johnny overhears the camp captain and Zim talking and learns Zim considers it his fault for not being fast enough and letting the boy hit him. Johnny starts to feel connection to them, but decides he is going to resign. This is not for him. However before he can they are sent on a long march, and he receives a letter from an old high school teacher and veteran who served in the MI, Dubois. Dubois was a high ranked officer, and his encouragement, despite them not being close in high school, helps Johnny continue on. He receives a letter from his mother but his father still hates him, and they see a deserter hanged for killing a baby girl.

Johnny makes a few friends and graduates with less than 200 of the 2,000 that started. Quickly, a war begins with an alien race called Bugs (large arachnid hivemind). The bugs bomb and destroy Buenos Aires, and Johnny later learns his mother was there and was killed. He and the MI are dropped onto the bugs home planet but suffer a major defeat. Since most of his unit died, he is assigned to the Roughnecks and we catch back up to the present after a few more combat drops. While on R&R (rest and recuperation) on Sanctuary (A secret paradise planet), Ace ends up telling Johnny he should go to officer school. Johnny enrolls in Officer Candidate School (OCS) and begins to train to be an officer. Right before he starts, he runs into his father at a shipyard. They are both happy to see each other. His father joined up after the Buenos Aires bombing, and they are friends now.

Johnny learns about being an officer. He has dinner with Carmen, who is now a Navy pilot, and we learn that Carl died in an attack on Pluto. During his training Johnny is given a temporary command post under Captain Blackstone, and they attack a bug outpost with the goal of capturing some of the hivemind brains. They succeed despite heavy losses, and Johnny getting hit by a falling rock and sent to the hospital ward for a month. We find out Zim was his sergeant for this operation and helped it go smoothly.

Blackstone sends him back to school with good comments and he graduates. Johnny ends up back on the Roger Young as lieutenant, with his dad as his second in command, leading a platoon called Rico’s Roughnecks, about to do a combat drop. THE END.

title: The Last Devil to Die
author: Richard Osman
summary:
The Last Devil to Die Richard Osman Thursday Murder Club #4 The Last Devil to Die Summary

Kuldesh, an antique shop owner, was killed just after Christmas. He had been given 100,00 pounds worth of Heroine in a terracotta box that he just needed to leave in his shop and someone would pick up the following day, but instead he hid it.

The Thursday Murder Club are trying to get to know Mervyn, a new resident at Cooper’s Chase and learn that he is falling for an online money scam, by someone pretending to be a young woman in love with him that needs cash for various reasons. Mervyn does not believe them, but does allow Ibrahim and their friend Bob to use his computer and try and catch the guy.

Chris and Donna get pulled off of Kuldesh’ murder case very early by the national drug agency, but Donna found Kuldesh’ phone and kept it. They are able to learn that Kuldesh called Nina Mishra, a professor at a university, and a blocked 777 number they can’t trace. Joyce and Elizabeth go to meet Nina and learn that she knew Kuldesh was occasionally involved in sketchy scenarios but she did not know why he was killed or where the heroine is.

The drug dealers, Mitch Maxwell and his subordinate Dominic Holt, are also both very anxious to find the drugs. Mitch got beat up by another drug dealer, Luca Butaci, who was supposed to end up with the Heroine. The gang goes to meet Dom Holt and he says to leave him alone and smashes Ron’s car a bit.

Joyce and Ibrahim track down Samantha, a local art forger and con artist. She and her husband Garth, a large, Canadian man, own an antique store also. They say they don’t know anything but seem to be lying.

Elizabeth is sidetracked taking care of Stephen, whose dementia is getting worse. They go to meet her friend Viktor in London and explore their possibilities. Bogdan and Donna do some off the grid police work and meet Dom Holt, who threatens them. Later, Chris and Patrice are also doing some undercover work and Chris finds Dom Holt dead in his office. Joyce takes pictures of a bunch of the files and they call the cops.

Elizabeth invites Luca, Mitch, Samantha, Garth, and Nina to a lunch at Cooper’s Chase. Kuldesh had a rental garage to store stuff, and they want to see who will go investigate it. Mitch is being threatened by the Afghans who produce Heroine and is still very desperate to find the Heroine.

Samantha gets hit on the back of the head and dies falling down a staircase, Garth has not been seen lately. Stephen uses drugs he got from Viktor and euthanizes himself, everyone is very sad. They hold a funeral.

Elizabeth realizes where the heroine is. Kuldesh brought it to Cooper’s Chase and buried it with Stephen in a garden. Garth meets with Luca and Mitch, then kills Luca for killing Samantha. Mitch and Garth head to Cooper’s Chase when they hear they have the heroine (Ibrahim told Connie Johnson in prison and she told other people).

Ibrahim also gets the online guy stealing money from Mervyn to come and he gets arrested, then Garth shows up and we learn the terracotta box the drugs were kept in was the valuable thing, worth 5-6 million. We also learn Nina killed Kuldesh when she learned about the box. THE END.

title: Blood Song
author: Anthony Ryan
summary:
Blood Song Anthony Ryan Raven’s Shadow #1

Blood Song Summary

Lord Vernier of the Alpieran Empire is introduced to the prisoner known as The Hope Killer. He has many names, Vaelin Al Sorna, Darkblade, Younghawk, Sword of the Unified Realm, but in this empire he killed the future emperor who was called the Hope. Lord Vernier is part of an escort taking him to fight a champion in the Meldinian Isles, where Vaelin is supposed to die. As they travel aboard a ship Lord Vernier, a chronicler and historian, asks to record Vaelin’s story.

Vaelin Al Sorna is the son of the Battle Lord of the United Realms. His father worked his way up from a commoner to be honored by King Janus. Vaelin’s mother disliked how often his father had to go and fight wars and killed people. Shortly after his mother died his father brought him to the Sixth Order, a religious convent where they trained warriors. His father left him and Vaelin was absorbed into the order with a class of other 10 year old boys. They are taught they have no outside family and their only family now are their brothers and sisters of The Faith.

The Faith does not have a God, and says that a God is a lie. There are six orders all specializing in something else. Vaelin is part of a small cadre with other boys, notably Norta, a spoiled noble’s son who hates being her; Caenis, a quiet boy who admires the king and royalty; Dentos, a whore’s son; Barkus, a blacksmith’s son; and a couple others. Together they train and become talented in all forms of combat, riding, woodcraft, and survival. Each year the trainees are given a test. The first year is test of the run. The boys are dropped off randomly along a river a good distance from the sixth order house, and have to return before the following dawn or they are kicked out of the order.

Vaelin gets an arrow shot at him, but an internal sense warns him and he dodges, and returns fire, killing a man. He is on guard and sneaks up on a fire he finds, and overhears two men talking about how they are hunting him. They killed and beheaded one of his groupmates instead. A large wolf appears and kills the men, and Vaeling buries the head of his friend then returns to complete the test. He meets with the Aspect of the Order, and is told that for now they must lie about what happened and say it was a bear attack. Vaelin hates lying but does anyway. The second year is the test of the wild. Each boy is left alone in the forest for a week during the winter and has to survive.

Vaelin makes a small shelter, but a terrible snow storm hits. He hears voices on the wind and goes to investigate and finds a man and young woman who he helps carry to his shelter. The next morning he learns the man is Eloan? And the girl also has a name. The girl is mute but Vaelin can read sign language since one of the masters at the sixth order uses it to teach. He learns from Eloan that the girl is a “denier”, someone who practices a different religion than the Faith. Deniers are punished and killed without exception, and Eloan helps them flee to other places. Vaelin spies some soldiers on horses nearby, and offers to help the pair. He takes the girls scarf to get her scent and runs in the opposite direction. The hounds chase him and his kills two before the third submit. One of the soldiers is about to kill him when Vaelin realizes they are off the Order. Another brother from the Fourth order shows up and deescalates the situation. Vaelin tells them he met the pair but did not know they were outlaws.
